3.7.10.d: देवा अन्योन्यस्य श्रैष्ठ्ये तिष्ठमानाश् चतुर्धा व्युदक्रामन्न् अग्निर् वसुभिः सोमो रुद्रैर् इन्द्रो मरुद्भिर् वरुण आदित्यैस् तान् वा एतेन बृहस्पतिर् अयाजयत् तेषाम् इन्द्रो ऽभवत् तद् य एतेन यजते भवति ते वा अन्योन्यस्याभिद्रोहाद् अबिभयुस् तेषां याः प्रियास् तन्वा आसंस् ताः समवाद्यंस् ताः समवामृशन् ॥ यो नस् तन् नपाद् यो नो ऽन्योन्यस्मै द्रुह्याद् इत एव सं निरृछात् ॥ इति ते यदा समवामृशंस् ततो देवा अभवन् परासुरास् तद् य एवं विद्वांसः समवमृशन्ति भवन्त्य् आत्मना परैषां भ्रातृव्या भवन्ति यं कामयेत ऋध्नुयाद् इति तं प्रथमम् अवमर्शयेद् ऋध्नोति यदि कामयेत सर्वे सदृशाः स्युर् इति सर्वान्त् सहावमर्शयेत् सर्वे ह सदृशा भवन्ति ये वै ते समवामृशन्न् अपि वा इदानीं ते ऽन्योन्यस्मै न द्रुह्यन्ति तस्मात् सतानूनप्त्रिणे न द्रोग्धवै यद् द्रुह्येत् प्रियायै तन्वै द्रुह्येत् ते वा अमुष्मिन्न् आदित्ये प्रियास् तन्वः संन्यदधत तस्माद् एष तेजिष्ठं तपति तस्मात् सूर्यदेवत्या हि सर्वे सोमा गृह्यन्ते ऽथो अत्र वै देवानां प्रियास् तन्वस् ता एवावरुन्द्ध आपतये त्वा गृह्णामीत्य् अग्नये तेन वसुभ्यो गृह्णाति परिपतये त्वेति सोमाय न रुतेद्रेभ्यस् तनूनप्त्रा इतीन्द्राय तेन मरुद्भ्यः शक्मने शाक्वरायेति वरुणाय तेनादित्येभ्य एतेभ्यो वै तद् देवेभ्यो ऽग्रे गृह्यते तेभ्य एवैनद् गृह्णाति चतुर् गृह्णाति चतुर्धा हि ते व्युदक्रामन्न् आपतये त्वा गृह्णामीत्य् आत्मानम् एव तेन गृह्णाति परिपतये त्वेति प्रजां तेन तनूनप्त्रा इति यज्ञं तेन शक्मने शाक्वरायेति पशूंस् तेन यो वै देवान्त् साध्यान् वेद सिध्यति ह वा अस्मै यत्र कामयेत इह मे सिध्येद् इतीमे वै लोका देवाः साध्या आत्मानम् एव दीक्षया स्पृणोति प्रजाम् अवान्तरदीक्षया संतराम् मेखलाम् आयछते कनीयो व्रतम् उपैत्य् अन्तरा ह्य् आत्मानं प्रजा द्विव्रतेन भवितव्यं द्वौ वा ऋतू अहश् च रात्रिश् च यद् एकव्रतः स्यात् पत्नीम् अन्तरियाद् या ते अग्ने रुद्रिया तनूर् इति व्रतं व्रतयत्य् एषा वा अस्मिन्न् एतर्हि देवता तां प्रीणाति तस्यां हुतं व्रतयति यद् एतो ऽन्यथा व्रतयेद् रुद्र एनम् अभिमानुकः स्याद् देवताभिर् वा एष सायुज्यं गछति यो दीक्षते यञ् शीताभिर् मार्जयेत शमयेयुर् अथो यथेदम् अद्भिर् अग्निर् उपसृष्ट एवं स्याद् अथ यत् तप्ताभिर् मार्जयते शान्त्यय् अथो तेजो वै मदन्तीस् तेज एवावरुन्द्धे ॥ इत्य् उपरिकाण्डे सप्तमः प्रपाठकः ॥
3.7.10.m:
The gods, disputing among each other for pre-eminence, stepped out into four divisions:
Agni with the Vasus,
Soma with the Rudras,
Indra with the Maruts,
Varuṇa with the Ādityas.
Bṛhaspati caused them to sacrifice with this [rite];
Indra became [pre-eminent] among them.
Therefore, he who sacrifices with this becomes [pre-eminent].
They indeed feared betrayal of one another;
what dear bodies they had, those they deposited together;
they touched them together [saying]:
"Whoever of us [breaks] that Tanūnaptra, whoever of us betrays one another, let him perish entirely from here!"
When they touched them together, thereupon the gods prevailed and the Asuras were defeated.
Therefore, those who, knowing thus, touch [it] together, prevail in person, and their rivals are defeated.
Whomsoever he might wish, "May he prosper," him he should cause to touch first;
he prospers.
If he should wish, "May all be equal," he should cause all to touch together;
all indeed become equal.
Those who indeed touched together then, even now they do not betray one another.
Therefore, one must not betray a fellow-sharer in the Tanūnaptra covenant.
If he were to betray, he would betray his own dear body.
They indeed deposited their dear bodies together in yonder sun;
therefore he burns most brilliantly.
Therefore, indeed, all Somas are taken with Sūrya as their deity.
And moreover, here indeed are the dear bodies of the gods;
those very [bodies] he secures.
"For the lord of the descent I take you," [he says];
thereby he takes for Agni, for the Vasus.
"For the lord of the circuit [I take] you," [he says];
for Soma, for the Rudras.
"By the Tanūnaptra," [he says];
thereby for Indra, for the Maruts.
"For strength, for the mighty," [he says];
thereby for Varuṇa, for the Ādityas.
Indeed, it is taken first for these deities;
he takes it just for them.
Four times he takes;
for in four divisions they stepped forth.
"For the lord of the descent I take you," [he says];
thereby he grasps his own self.
"For the lord of the circuit [I take] you," [he says];
thereby offspring.
"By the Tanūnaptra," [he says];
thereby the sacrifice.
"For strength, for the mighty," [he says];
thereby cattle.
Whoever indeed knows the Sādhya gods, it succeeds indeed for him,
wherever he might wish, "May it succeed for me here."
These worlds indeed are the Sādhya gods.
He rescues his own self by the consecration, offspring by the intermediate consecration.
He draws the girdle closer.
He approaches smaller vow-food.
For offspring are intermediate to oneself.
There should be twofold vow-food.
Two indeed are the seasons: day and night.
If he were to observe a single vow-food, he would exclude the wife.
"What fierce body of yours, O Agni," saying this, he consumes the vow-food.
This indeed is the deity in him at that time;
he gratifies it;
he consumes the vow-food as an offering into it.
If he were to consume the vow-food otherwise than this, Rudra would be liable to harm him.
He indeed goes to union with the deities
who undergoes consecration. If he were to cleanse himself with cold [waters], they would extinguish [him], and it would be just as when fire is poured over with water.
Now, in that he cleanses himself with heated [waters],
[it is] for pacification.
Moreover, the boiling waters are fiery energy;
he secures fiery energy itself.
Thus ends the seventh prapāṭhaka in the upper kāṇḍa.

3.8.1.s: asurāṇāṃ vā eṣu lokeṣu pura āsann ayasmayy asmiṃl loke rajatāntarikṣe hiriṇī divi te devāḥ saṃstambhaṃsaṃstambhaṃ parājayantānāyatanā hy āsaṃs ta etāḥ pratipuro 'manvita havirdhānaṃ divy āgnīdhram antarikṣe sadaḥ pṛthivyāṃ te 'bruvann upasīdāmopasadā vai mahāpuraṃ jayantīti ta upāsīdaṃs tad upasadām upasattvaṃ tān ebhyo lokebhyaḥ prāṇudanta ta ebhyo lokebhyaḥ praṇuttā ahar aśrayanta yat prātar upasadam upāyann ahna enāṃs tena prāṇudanta te 'hnaḥ praṇuttā rātrīm aśrayanta yat sāyam upasadam upāyan rātryā enāṃs tena prāṇudanta tato devā abhavan parāsurās tad ya evaṃ vidvān upasadam upaity ahorātrābhyām eva bhrātṛvyam ebhyo lokebhyaḥ praṇudate bhavaty ātmanā parāsya bhrātṛvyo bhavaty atha vai tarhi neṣur āsīt te devā etām iṣuṃ samaskurvann agniṃ śṛṅgaṃ somaṃ śalyaṃ viṣṇuṃ kulmalaṃ te 'bruvan ka imām iṣum avasrakṣyatīti te devā abruvann ayam eva rudra iti so 'bravīd bhāgo me 'stv iti vṛṇīṣvety avadan so 'bravīn naivam ekaś caneṣum astām mīmāṃsātā iti tasmād etasyeṣur astā na mīmāṃsitavyā || satyaṃham || ity eva brūyāt tāṃ vai rudro vyasṛjad eṣa hi devānāṃ krūratamas tayemāḥ puro 'bhinad agninā vai sa tās tejasābhinat tasmād agniḥ prathama ijyate yad anyāṃ devatāṃ pūrvāṃ yajed avīryavatīḥ syur aṣṭau kṛtvo juhvāṃ gṛhṇāti catur upabhṛti pūrvārdho hīṣoḥ samāhitatamaḥ sakṛt parāṅ atikrāmati sakṛd dhy eveṣuḥ parācy apatad atikramyāśrāvayati yajñasyābhijityai yad anatikramyāśrāvayed anabhijito 'sya yajñaḥ syāt sruveṇopasado juhoti purāṃ vā eṣa jitānām anvāroha ekām ekāhaṃ juhoty ekām ekāham ekāṃ hi ta ekāham ajayann ekām ekāhaṃ tisra upasado juhoti trayo vā ime lokā eṣāṃ lokānām abhijityay agninā vai mukhena devā imāṃl lokān anvavāyann upasadbhir asurān parāṇudyāgninā vā etan mukhena yajamāna imāṃl lokān anvavaity upasadbhir bhrātṛvyaṃ parāṇudya yāḥ sāyam anuvākyās tāḥ prātar yājyāḥ syur yāḥ prātar anuvākyās tāḥ sāyaṃ yājyāḥ syus tathobhayīr vīryavatīr bhavanti ||
3.8.1.d: असुराणां वा एषु लोकेषु पुर आसन्न् अयस्मय्य् अस्मिंल् लोके रजतान्तरिक्षे हिरिणी दिवि ते देवाः संस्तम्भंसंस्तम्भं पराजयन्तानायतना ह्य् आसंस् त एताः प्रतिपुरो ऽमन्वित हविर्धानं दिव्य् आग्नीध्रम् अन्तरिक्षे सदः पृथिव्यां ते ऽब्रुवन्न् उपसीदामोपसदा वै महापुरं जयन्तीति त उपासीदंस् तद् उपसदाम् उपसत्त्वं तान् एभ्यो लोकेभ्यः प्राणुदन्त त एभ्यो लोकेभ्यः प्रणुत्ता अहर् अश्रयन्त यत् प्रातर् उपसदम् उपायन्न् अह्न एनांस् तेन प्राणुदन्त ते ऽह्नः प्रणुत्ता रात्रीम् अश्रयन्त यत् सायम् उपसदम् उपायन् रात्र्या एनांस् तेन प्राणुदन्त ततो देवा अभवन् परासुरास् तद् य एवं विद्वान् उपसदम् उपैत्य् अहोरात्राभ्याम् एव भ्रातृव्यम् एभ्यो लोकेभ्यः प्रणुदते भवत्य् आत्मना परास्य भ्रातृव्यो भवत्य् अथ वै तर्हि नेषुर् आसीत् ते देवा एताम् इषुं समस्कुर्वन्न् अग्निं शृङ्गं सोमं शल्यं विष्णुं कुल्मलं ते ऽब्रुवन् क इमाम् इषुम् अवस्रक्ष्यतीति ते देवा अब्रुवन्न् अयम् एव रुद्र इति सो ऽब्रवीद् भागो मे ऽस्त्व् इति वृणीष्वेत्य् अवदन् सो ऽब्रवीन् नैवम् एकश् चनेषुम् अस्ताम् मीमांसाता इति तस्माद् एतस्येषुर् अस्ता न मीमांसितव्या ॥ सत्यंहम् ॥ इत्य् एव ब्रूयात् तां वै रुद्रो व्यसृजद् एष हि देवानां क्रूरतमस् तयेमाः पुरो ऽभिनद् अग्निना वै स तास् तेजसाभिनत् तस्माद् अग्निः प्रथम इज्यते यद् अन्यां देवतां पूर्वां यजेद् अवीर्यवतीः स्युर् अष्टौ कृत्वो जुह्वां गृह्णाति चतुर् उपभृति पूर्वार्धो हीषोः समाहिततमः सकृत् पराङ् अतिक्रामति सकृद् ध्य् एवेषुः पराच्य् अपतद् अतिक्रम्याश्रावयति यज्ञस्याभिजित्यै यद् अनतिक्रम्याश्रावयेद् अनभिजितो ऽस्य यज्ञः स्यात् स्रुवेणोपसदो जुहोति पुरां वा एष जितानाम् अन्वारोह एकाम् एकाहं जुहोत्य् एकाम् एकाहम् एकां हि त एकाहम् अजयन्न् एकाम् एकाहं तिस्र उपसदो जुहोति त्रयो वा इमे लोका एषां लोकानाम् अभिजित्यय् अग्निना वै मुखेन देवा इमांल् लोकान् अन्ववायन्न् उपसद्भिर् असुरान् पराणुद्याग्निना वा एतन् मुखेन यजमान इमांल् लोकान् अन्ववैत्य् उपसद्भिर् भ्रातृव्यं पराणुद्य याः सायम् अनुवाक्यास् ताः प्रातर् याज्याः स्युर् याः प्रातर् अनुवाक्यास् ताः सायं याज्याः स्युस् तथोभयीर् वीर्यवतीर् भवन्ति ॥
3.8.1.m:
The Asuras indeed had citadels in these worlds:
an iron one in this world,
a silver one in the intermediate space,
a golden one in heaven.
Those gods were repeatedly defeated at each supportive stance;
for they had no proper place.
They conceived these counter-citadels:
the Havirdhāna in heaven,
the Āgnīdhra in the intermediate space,
the Sadas on earth.
They said:
"Let us besiege [them];
by siege (Upasad) indeed do they conquer a great citadel."
They besieged [them];
that is the sieging nature of the Upasads.
They drove them out from these worlds.
Driven out from these worlds, they took refuge in the day.
When they performed the Upasad in the morning, they drove them out from the day thereby.
Driven out from the day, they took refuge in the night.
When they performed the Upasad in the evening, they drove them out from the night thereby.
Thereupon the gods prevailed and the Asuras were defeated.
Therefore, he who, knowing thus, performs the Upasad, drives out his rival from these worlds by means of day and night;
he prevails in person;
his rival is defeated.
Now at that time there was no arrow.
Those gods prepared this arrow:
Agni the point,
Soma the barb,
Viṣṇu the socket.
They said:
"Who will discharge this arrow?"
Those gods said:
"Rudra here."
He said:
"Let there be a share for me."
"Choose!" they said.
He said:
"Let not even a single one question the arrow-shooter [about his act]."
Therefore, his arrow-shooter must not be questioned.
"Truly indeed!" thus only should one say.
Rudra indeed discharged it;
for he is the cruelest of the gods.
With it he shattered these citadels.
With Agni indeed, with fiery energy, he shattered them.
Therefore Agni is sacrificed to first.
If he were to sacrifice to another deity first, they would be devoid of virility.
Eight times he takes into the Juhū, four times into the Upabhṛt;
for the front part of the arrow is the most well-composed.
Once he steps across, facing away;
for once only the arrow flew away, facing away.
Having stepped across, he causes [the Āgnīdhra] to call for the Śraukṣa,
for the conquest of the sacrifice.
If he were to cause him to call without having stepped across, his sacrifice would be unconquered.
With the Sruva he offers the Upasads;
this is an ascent-oblation of the conquered citadels.
One he offers on one day, one on one day;
for they conquered one on one day, one on one day.
He offers three Upasads;
three indeed are these worlds,
for the conquest of these worlds.
With Agni as the mouth, the gods indeed entered these worlds, having driven away the Asuras by the Upasads.
With Agni as the mouth, the sacrificer indeed enters these worlds, having driven away his rival by the Upasads.
Those which are the invitatory verses in the evening should be the offering verses in the morning;
those which are the invitatory verses in the morning should be the offering verses in the evening;
thus both become endowed with virility.

3.8.2.s: ayaḥ prathamāyām avadhāya juhoti rajataṃ madhyamāyāṃ haritam uttamāyām etad vai bṛhaspatir devebhyaḥ pūrjayanam akarod yatra puraṃ yudhyeyus tad etābhir juhuyāt sarā vā eṣā yajñasya tasmād yat kiṃca prācīnam agnīṣomīyāt tad upāṃśu caranty atha vā etad agnīṣomīyaṃ prati vācaṃ visṛjante yajñam evāptvā vācaṃ visṛjante ghṛtaṃ vai devā vajraṃ kṛtvā somam aghnan srucau bāhū tasmāt srucau saumīm āhutiṃ nāśāte avadhiṣur vā etat somaṃ yad asya srucau cājyaṃ cāntikam abhārṣur yad āhāṃśuraṃśuṣ ṭe deva somāpyāyatām iti yad evāsya ghnantaḥ krūram akraṃs tad akrūram akas tad āpyāyayati sarva ṛtvijā āpyāyayanti sarve hi tāntaṃ bhiṣajyanti yanti vā ete 'smāl lokād ye somam āpyāyayitum udasthuḥ parāñco hi yantīśvarāḥ prametor yad āhaiṣṭā rāyā eṣṭā vāmāni preṣe bhagāyeti tenāsmāl lokān naiti tenāsmiṃl loke dhṛtā anayor vā eṣa garbha ābhyām eṣa āvṛścate yaḥ somaṃ hanti yad āha namo dive namaḥ pṛthivyā ity ābhyām eva namo 'kar ātithyaṃ vā upasadāṃ prayājās tānūnaptram āśīs tasmān na hotāraṃ vṛṇīte nārṣeyam || sīda hotaḥ || ity evāha caturvratas tisraś catvāri hīṣoḥ parṇāni trivratas tisras triṣandhir hīṣuḥ śṛṅgaṃ śalyaḥ kulmalaṃ dvivratas tisro dviṣandhir hīṣuḥ śalyaś ca kulmalaṃ caikavratas tisra ekā hy eveṣur eṣā vai parovarīyasī dīkṣā kanīyo vratam upaiti jyāyāṃsaṃ lokam abhijayaty ekavratas tisro dvivratas tisras trivratas tisraś caturvratas tisra eṣā vā utkrāmantī svargakāmasyottaramuttaraṃ śvaḥśvaḥ śreyān bhavati ya evaṃ veda yad dvādaśāgniṣṭomasyopasadaḥ syur aśāntā nidaheyur yat tisro 'hinasya yathā garīyān bhāra uṣṇihāṃ niśṛṇāty evaṃ tat tat tisra evāgniṣṭomasyopasadaḥ kāryā dvādaśāhinasya savīryatvāya ||
3.8.2.d: अयः प्रथमायाम् अवधाय जुहोति रजतं मध्यमायां हरितम् उत्तमायाम् एतद् वै बृहस्पतिर् देवेभ्यः पूर्जयनम् अकरोद् यत्र पुरं युध्येयुस् तद् एताभिर् जुहुयात् सरा वा एषा यज्ञस्य तस्माद् यत् किंच प्राचीनम् अग्नीषोमीयात् तद् उपांशु चरन्त्य् अथ वा एतद् अग्नीषोमीयं प्रति वाचं विसृजन्ते यज्ञम् एवाप्त्वा वाचं विसृजन्ते घृतं वै देवा वज्रं कृत्वा सोमम् अघ्नन् स्रुचौ बाहू तस्मात् स्रुचौ सौमीम् आहुतिं नाशाते अवधिषुर् वा एतत् सोमं यद् अस्य स्रुचौ चाज्यं चान्तिकम् अभार्षुर् यद् आहांशुरंशुष् टे देव सोमाप्यायताम् इति यद् एवास्य घ्नन्तः क्रूरम् अक्रंस् तद् अक्रूरम् अकस् तद् आप्याययति सर्व ऋत्विजा आप्याययन्ति सर्वे हि तान्तं भिषज्यन्ति यन्ति वा एते ऽस्माल् लोकाद् ये सोमम् आप्याययितुम् उदस्थुः पराञ्चो हि यन्तीश्वराः प्रमेतोर् यद् आहैष्टा राया एष्टा वामानि प्रेषे भगायेति तेनास्माल् लोकान् नैति तेनास्मिंल् लोके धृता अनयोर् वा एष गर्भ आभ्याम् एष आवृश्चते यः सोमं हन्ति यद् आह नमो दिवे नमः पृथिव्या इत्य् आभ्याम् एव नमो ऽकर् आतिथ्यं वा उपसदां प्रयाजास् तानूनप्त्रम् आशीस् तस्मान् न होतारं वृणीते नार्षेयम् ॥ सीद होतः ॥ इत्य् एवाह चतुर्व्रतस् तिस्रश् चत्वारि हीषोः पर्णानि त्रिव्रतस् तिस्रस् त्रिषन्धिर् हीषुः शृङ्गं शल्यः कुल्मलं द्विव्रतस् तिस्रो द्विषन्धिर् हीषुः शल्यश् च कुल्मलं चैकव्रतस् तिस्र एका ह्य् एवेषुर् एषा वै परोवरीयसी दीक्षा कनीयो व्रतम् उपैति ज्यायांसं लोकम् अभिजयत्य् एकव्रतस् तिस्रो द्विव्रतस् तिस्रस् त्रिव्रतस् तिस्रश् चतुर्व्रतस् तिस्र एषा वा उत्क्रामन्ती स्वर्गकामस्योत्तरमुत्तरं श्वःश्वः श्रेयान् भवति य एवं वेद यद् द्वादशाग्निष्टोमस्योपसदः स्युर् अशान्ता निदहेयुर् यत् तिस्रो ऽहिनस्य यथा गरीयान् भार उष्णिहां निशृणात्य् एवं तत् तत् तिस्र एवाग्निष्टोमस्योपसदः कार्या द्वादशाहिनस्य सवीर्यत्वाय ॥
3.8.2.m:
Having placed [a piece of] iron in the first [layer], he offers;
[a piece of] silver in the middle one;
[a piece of] gold in the highest one.
This indeed Bṛhaspati made as a citadel-conquering [rite] for the gods.
Where they might fight for a citadel, there he should offer with these.
This [part] indeed is the sap of the sacrifice;
therefore, whatever is prior to the [sacrifice] for Agni and Soma, they perform that in a whisper.
Now indeed, at the [sacrifice] for Agni and Soma, they release speech.
Having reached the sacrifice itself, they release speech.
The gods, having made butter into a vajra, struck Soma.
The two offering spoons are the two arms;
therefore the two offering spoons do not taste the oblation of Soma.
They indeed struck Soma here, in that they brought the two offering spoons and butter near him.
When he says:
"May every shoot of yours, divine Soma, swell!",
what cruel [harm] they did to him while striking, that you have made free from cruelty.
He thereby makes it swell.
All the officiating priests make it swell;
for all treat the exhausted one medically.
Those who have stood up to make Soma swell indeed depart from this world,
for they go away [from here];
they are likely to perish.
When he says:
"Treasures are desired, desirable things are desired, forward to impulse, to Bhaga!",
thereby he does not depart from this world;
thereby they are supported in this world.
This one is indeed the embryo of these two [worlds];
he who strikes Soma is cut off from these two.
When he says:
"Homage to heaven, homage to earth!",
he has indeed paid homage to these two.
The hospitality [offering] is indeed the fore-offerings of the Upasads;
the Tanūnaptra is the blessing;
therefore he neither chooses a Hotṛ nor mentions the ṛṣi-lineage.
He merely says: "Sit down, O Hotṛ!"
Three [Upasads] with four vow-foods;
for the arrow has four feathers.
Three with three vow-foods;
for the arrow has three joints: the point, the barb, and the socket.
Three with two vow-foods;
for the arrow has two joints: the barb and the socket.
Three with a single vow-food;
for the arrow is indeed single.
This indeed is the consecration broadening further and further: he approaches a lesser vow-food,
[and] conquers a greater world.
Three with a single vow-food,
three with two vow-foods,
three with three vow-foods,
three with four vow-foods:
this indeed is the ascending [consecration] of one who desires heaven.
Higher and higher, better and better day after day becomes he who knows thus.
If there should be twelve Upasads of an Agniṣṭoma, unpacified they would burn [it] down.
If three of an Ahīna, that is as when a heavier load breaks down the neck of a beast of burden.
Therefore only three Upasads are to be performed for an Agniṣṭoma, twelve for an Ahīna,
for the sake of equal vigor.

3.8.3.s: abhyardho vai devebhyo yajña āsīt te nāvidur iha vā sa iha vety asti yajña iti tv avidus tena vai saṃsṛṣṭim aichaṃs taṃ praiṣam aichan tan nāvindaṃs taṃ vayāṃsy uparyupari nātyayataṃs tam indra uparyupary atyakrāmat tam acāyat so 'ved aciked vai meti so 'bravīt ko 'sā ity ahaṃ durge hantety atha kas tvam asīty ahaṃ durgād āharteti so 'bravīd durge vai hantāvocathā ayaṃ varāha āmukha ekaviṃśatyāḥ purāṃ pāre 'śmamayīnāṃ tasminn asurāṇāṃ vasu vāmam antas taṃ jahīti tasyendro druṃbhūlyābhyāyatya purastād bhittvā hṛdayaṃ prāvṛścad etad vā eṣābhyanūktā || atividdhā vithureṇā cid astās triḥsapta sānu saṃhitā girīṇām | na tad devo na martyas tuturyād yāni pravṛddho vṛṣabhaś cakāra || iti so 'bravīd durgād vā āhartāvocathā etam āhareti taṃ vai viṣṇur āharad yajño vai viṣṇur yajño vai tad yajñam asurebhyo 'dhy āharad yajñena vai tad yajñaṃ devā asurāṇām avindantaitad vā eṣābhyanūktā || viśvet tā viṣṇur ābharad urukramas tveṣitaḥ | śataṃ mahiṣān kṣīrapākam odanaṃ varāham indra emuṣam || iti tad vai devā yajñam avindan yad vai tad yajñam avindaṃs tad devāyajanasya devayajanatvaṃ yad devayajanam ichanti yajñam ichanti yad vindanti yajñaṃ vindanti yad vāva yajamāno joṣayate tad devayajanaṃ yajñaṃ vāvaitad yajamāno joṣayate 'surāṇāṃ vā iyam agra āsīd yāvan niṣadya parāpaśyaṃs tad devānāṃ te devāḥ salāvṛkīm abruvan yāvad iyaṃ triḥ samantaṃ paryeti tad asmākam iti sā vā imāṃ triḥ samantaṃ paryait tad vai devā imām avindanta tad vedyā veditvaṃ viṣṇuṃ vai devā ānayan vāmanaṃ kṛtvā yāvad ayaṃ trir vikramate tad asmākam iti sa vā idam evāgre vyakramatāthedam athādas tad vai devā iha mām avindanta tad vedyā veditvaṃ sarvā vā iyaṃ pṛthivī vedir iyaṃ mekhalam iti tv evāsyā yajamānaḥ parigṛhṇīte yāvadyāvad vai yajamāno vedyāḥ kurute tāvatāttāvattāt pṛthivyā jayati tasmān mahatī kāryā jyāyasījyāyasī devāś ca vā asurāś cāspardhanta tad yat kiṃcāsurāṇāṃ svam āsīt tad devā vedyāvindanta tad vedyā veditvaṃ teṣāṃ yat priyaṃ vasv āsīt tenāpādhāvann anena cin mucyāmahā iti tad devā uttaravedyāvindanta tad uttaraṃ vai śreyo 'vidāmahīti tad uttaravedyā uttaraveditvaṃ tad ya evaṃ vidvān vediṃ cottaravediṃ ca kurute 'bhipūrvam eva sapatnasya bhrātṛvyasya vasu vedo vṛñjāna eti ||
3.8.3.d: अभ्यर्धो वै देवेभ्यो यज्ञ आसीत् ते नाविदुर् इह वा स इह वेत्य् अस्ति यज्ञ इति त्व् अविदुस् तेन वै संसृष्टिम् ऐछंस् तं प्रैषम् ऐछन् तन् नाविन्दंस् तं वयांस्य् उपर्युपरि नात्ययतंस् तम् इन्द्र उपर्युपर्य् अत्यक्रामत् तम् अचायत् सो ऽवेद् अचिकेद् वै मेति सो ऽब्रवीत् को ऽसा इत्य् अहं दुर्गे हन्तेत्य् अथ कस् त्वम् असीत्य् अहं दुर्गाद् आहर्तेति सो ऽब्रवीद् दुर्गे वै हन्तावोचथा अयं वराह आमुख एकविंशत्याः पुरां पारे ऽश्ममयीनां तस्मिन्न् असुराणां वसु वामम् अन्तस् तं जहीति तस्येन्द्रो द्रुंभूल्याभ्यायत्य पुरस्ताद् भित्त्वा हृदयं प्रावृश्चद् एतद् वा एषाभ्यनूक्ता ॥ अतिविद्धा विथुरेणा चिद् अस्तास् त्रिःसप्त सानु संहिता गिरीणाम् । न तद् देवो न मर्त्यस् तुतुर्याद् यानि प्रवृद्धो वृषभश् चकार ॥ इति सो ऽब्रवीद् दुर्गाद् वा आहर्तावोचथा एतम् आहरेति तं वै विष्णुर् आहरद् यज्ञो वै विष्णुर् यज्ञो वै तद् यज्ञम् असुरेभ्यो ऽध्य् आहरद् यज्ञेन वै तद् यज्ञं देवा असुराणाम् अविन्दन्तैतद् वा एषाभ्यनूक्ता ॥ विश्वेत् ता विष्णुर् आभरद् उरुक्रमस् त्वेषितः । शतं महिषान् क्षीरपाकम् ओदनं वराहम् इन्द्र एमुषम् ॥ इति तद् वै देवा यज्ञम् अविन्दन् यद् वै तद् यज्ञम् अविन्दंस् तद् देवायजनस्य देवयजनत्वं यद् देवयजनम् इछन्ति यज्ञम् इछन्ति यद् विन्दन्ति यज्ञं विन्दन्ति यद् वाव यजमानो जोषयते तद् देवयजनं यज्ञं वावैतद् यजमानो जोषयते ऽसुराणां वा इयम् अग्र आसीद् यावन् निषद्य परापश्यंस् तद् देवानां ते देवाः सलावृकीम् अब्रुवन् यावद् इयं त्रिः समन्तं पर्येति तद् अस्माकम् इति सा वा इमां त्रिः समन्तं पर्यैत् तद् वै देवा इमाम् अविन्दन्त तद् वेद्या वेदित्वं विष्णुं वै देवा आनयन् वामनं कृत्वा यावद् अयं त्रिर् विक्रमते तद् अस्माकम् इति स वा इदम् एवाग्रे व्यक्रमताथेदम् अथादस् तद् वै देवा इह माम् अविन्दन्त तद् वेद्या वेदित्वं सर्वा वा इयं पृथिवी वेदिर् इयं मेखलम् इति त्व् एवास्या यजमानः परिगृह्णीते यावद्यावद् वै यजमानो वेद्याः कुरुते तावतात्तावत्तात् पृथिव्या जयति तस्मान् महती कार्या ज्यायसीज्यायसी देवाश् च वा असुराश् चास्पर्धन्त तद् यत् किंचासुराणां स्वम् आसीत् तद् देवा वेद्याविन्दन्त तद् वेद्या वेदित्वं तेषां यत् प्रियं वस्व् आसीत् तेनापाधावन्न् अनेन चिन् मुच्यामहा इति तद् देवा उत्तरवेद्याविन्दन्त तद् उत्तरं वै श्रेयो ऽविदामहीति तद् उत्तरवेद्या उत्तरवेदित्वं तद् य एवं विद्वान् वेदिं चोत्तरवेदिं च कुरुते ऽभिपूर्वम् एव सपत्नस्य भ्रातृव्यस्य वसु वेदो वृञ्जान एति ॥
3.8.3.m:
The sacrifice was indeed apart from the gods.
They did not know:
"Is it here, or is it here?"
"The sacrifice exists!"—
this only they knew.
With it indeed they sought union;
they sought a search for it;
they did not find it.
Birds did not fly above and beyond it.
Indra stepped above and beyond it;
he perceived it.
It knew:
"He has indeed perceived me."
He said:
"Who is that?"
"I am the slayer in the stronghold."
"Then who are you?"
"I am the bringer from the stronghold."
He said:
"You indeed declared yourself the slayer in the stronghold.
This boar, the snout-faced one, is beyond twenty-one stone citadels;
in it is the lovely wealth of the Asuras.
Slay him!"
Indra, having aimed at him with a reed-stalk, having pierced [him] from the front, tore out his heart.
This indeed is recited with reference to this:
"Pierced through even by a trembling archer, thrice seven summits of the mountains united; / that neither god nor mortal could do, which the grown bull has done."
He said:
"You indeed declared yourself the bringer from the stronghold;
bring this!"
Viṣṇu indeed brought it.
Viṣṇu is indeed the sacrifice;
the sacrifice indeed then brought the sacrifice from the Asuras.
By the sacrifice the gods then found the sacrifice of the Asuras.
This indeed is recited with reference to this:
"All those Viṣṇu brought, the wide-striding, impelled by you: / a hundred buffaloes, milk-boiled rice, [and] the boar, the stealer, O Indra."
Then indeed the gods found the sacrifice.
Because they then found the sacrifice, that is the place-of-worship nature of the place of worship (devayajana).
When they seek a place of worship, they seek the sacrifice;
when they find [it], they find the sacrifice.
Whatever the sacrificer finds pleasure in, that is the place of worship;
the sacrificer indeed finds pleasure in the sacrifice here.
This [earth] indeed belonged to the Asuras at first.
As far as they saw looking away while sitting down, that belonged to the gods.
Those gods said to the female jackal:
"As far as this [earth] she runs around thrice all about, that is ours!"
She ran around this [earth] thrice all about; thereby the gods found this [earth].
That is the vedi-nature of the altar (vedi).
The gods indeed brought Viṣṇu, having made [him] a dwarf:
"As far as this one strides three times, that is ours!"
He strode over this [earth] indeed first,
then this [intermediate space], then that [heaven].
Thereby the gods found me here.
That is the vedi-nature of the altar.
This whole earth is indeed the vedi;
"This is the girdle [of the earth]," thinking thus the sacrificer encloses it.
As much as the sacrificer makes for the vedi, by just that much from the earth he conquers.
Therefore a large one is to be made, greater and greater.
The gods and the Asuras indeed contended.
Then whatever was the property of the Asuras, that the gods found by means of the vedi.
That is the vedi-nature of the altar.
Whatever dear wealth belonged to them, with that they ran away, [thinking]: "May we be saved at least with this!"
That the gods found by means of the Uttara-vedi.
"We have indeed found a higher (uttara) good!" [they thought];
that is the Uttara-vedi-nature of the Uttara-vedi.
Therefore he who, knowing thus, makes the vedi and the Uttara-vedi, goes on seizing consecutively the wealth and possession of his rival, of his enemy.

3.8.4.s: ṣaṭtriṃśat prakramāḥ prācī caturviṃśatir agreṇa triṃśaj jaghanena tathā virājā saṃmitātho chandāṃsi vai virāṭ chandāṃsi vāvāsyaitad yajñamukhe yunakty etad vā eṣābhyanuktā || indrāṇī patyā sujitaṃ jigāyodaṃśena patividye bibheda | triṃśad yasyā jaghanaṃ yojanāny upasthā indraṃ sthaviraṃ bibharti || iti yad vāva prācīnapravaṇaṃ tad devayajanaṃ prāñcaṃ hi taṃ śayānam avidann atha yat prācīnapravaṇam udīcīnāpanataṃ tad yajeta yaḥ kāmayetobhayor lokayor ṛdhnuyām ity ubhayor vā etal lokayor ubhayor eva lokayor ṛdhnoty atha yasya devayajanasyottarād anyad devayajanaṃ tad yajeta yaḥ kāmayetābhi mottaro yajño named ity etad vā uttarāvan nāma devayajanam abhy enam uttaro yajño namaty atha yasya devayajanasya madhyato bahulā oṣadhayas tat paśukāmo yajeta paśavo vā oṣadhayaḥ paśumān bhavati yat samaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ tad gataśrīr yajeta pratiṣṭhitaṃ vā etat pratiṣṭhita eṣa yo gataśrīs tad evainaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati pāpo hi sa tataḥ pracyavamāno 'tha yasya devayajanasyāpaḥ purastāt tad yajeta yaḥ kāmayetābhi mottaro yajño named ity etad vai purohavir nāma devayajanam abhy enam uttaro yajño namaty atha yasya devayajanasya panthāḥ purastād iriṇaṃ vā karto vā bhrātṛvyavān yajetaitad vā āptaṃ devayajanaṃ sadevaṃ yad dhi devayajanād devayajanam uñśiṃṣed bhrātṛvyāya lokam uñśiṃṣed atha yasya devayajanasyāhavanīyād anyāḥ prācīr āpo dhāvanti gārhapatyād anyāḥ pratīcīs tad yajeta yaṃ talpe vā pātre vā mīmāṃserann anuṣakto hi vā eṣa pāpmanāthaitan mīmāṃsanta etad vai vyāvṛttaṃ pāpmanā pāpmanaivainaṃ vyāvartayanti yad vai yajñaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate prācīnam asya samṛddham eti pratīcīnaṃ vyṛddhaṃ paśavo vai yajñasya samṛddham āpaḥ khalu vai paśavo yat pratyaṅṅ avabhṛtham abhyaveyād yajñasya vyṛdhyena vyṛdhyetātha yat prāṅ avabhṛtham abhyavaiti yajñasya vā etat samṛdhyena samṛdhyate yat tryunnataṃ tad bhrātṛvyavān yajeta yasyāhavanīyaṃ ca havirdhānaṃ cāntaronnataṃ yasya havirdhānaṃ ca sadaś cāntaronnataṃ yasya sadaś ca gārhapatyaṃ cāntaronnatam ato vai viṣṇur imāṃl lokān udajayad viṣṇor evojjitam anv imāṃl lokān ujjayati praibhyo lokebhyo bhrātṛvyaṃ nudate 'tha yasya devayajanasya dakṣiṇata unnataṃ tad bhrātṛvyavān yajetaitāṃ vai diśaṃ devā asurān praṇudya svargaṃ lokam āyann athaibhyo 'mum ādityaṃ paridhiṃ paryadadhur apunarābhāvāyaitāṃ vā etad diśaṃ yajamāno bhrātṛvyaṃ praṇudya svargaṃ lokam ety athāsmā amum ādityaṃ paridhiṃ paridadhāty apunarābhāvāya sthale yajeta yaḥ kāmayetobhayeṣāṃ devamanuṣyāṇāṃ prakāśaṃ gacheyam iti prakāśo vai nāmaitad devayajanam ubhayeṣāṃ devamanuṣyāṇāṃ prakāśaṃ gachaty abhiśasyamānaṃ yājayet parokṣaṃ guhā vane parokṣaṃ pṛṣṭhāny apeyuḥ parokṣaṃ vā eṣa yam abhiśaṃsanti parokṣam evāsmād guhā pāpīyāṃ vācaṃ karoty atha yasya hotā prātaranuvākam anubruvann agnim apaḥ sūryaṃ tāni paśyet tad brahmavarcasakāmo yajeta brahmavarcasaṃ vā agnir brahmavarcasam āpo brahmavarcasam asmā ādityo brahmavarcasam eva saṃdadhāti brahmavarcasī bhavaty atha yasya devayajanasyānyāanyā madhyato bahulā oṣadhayo 'to vā aṅgirasaḥ paśūn asṛjanta tat paśukāmo yajetātha yasya devayajanasya madhyata unnatam ato vā aṅgirasaḥ svargaṃ lokam āyaṃs tat svargakāmo yajeta nirvaske 'bhicaran yajeta yathaivaitaṃ nirṇayaty evaṃ taṃ nirṇayati yam abhicarati yat kāryam iva syāt tad yajeta yaḥ kārya iva syād ātmā vai devayajanaṃ karoty evainaṃ ye yuvāna ārṣeyā ṛtvijo vahnayas tad devayajanaṃ tasmād āhur yuvaivārtvijīnā ity agnir vāva devayajanaṃ tad ya evaṃ vidvān yatraiva kvacāgnim ādhāya yajate devayajana eva yajate ||
3.8.4.d: षट्त्रिंशत् प्रक्रमाः प्राची चतुर्विंशतिर् अग्रेण त्रिंशज् जघनेन तथा विराजा संमिताथो छन्दांसि वै विराट् छन्दांसि वावास्यैतद् यज्ञमुखे युनक्त्य् एतद् वा एषाभ्यनुक्ता ॥ इन्द्राणी पत्या सुजितं जिगायोदंशेन पतिविद्ये बिभेद । त्रिंशद् यस्या जघनं योजनान्य् उपस्था इन्द्रं स्थविरं बिभर्ति ॥ इति यद् वाव प्राचीनप्रवणं तद् देवयजनं प्राञ्चं हि तं शयानम् अविदन्न् अथ यत् प्राचीनप्रवणम् उदीचीनापनतं तद् यजेत यः कामयेतोभयोर् लोकयोर् ऋध्नुयाम् इत्य् उभयोर् वा एतल् लोकयोर् उभयोर् एव लोकयोर् ऋध्नोत्य् अथ यस्य देवयजनस्योत्तराद् अन्यद् देवयजनं तद् यजेत यः कामयेताभि मोत्तरो यज्ञो नमेद् इत्य् एतद् वा उत्तरावन् नाम देवयजनम् अभ्य् एनम् उत्तरो यज्ञो नमत्य् अथ यस्य देवयजनस्य मध्यतो बहुला ओषधयस् तत् पशुकामो यजेत पशवो वा ओषधयः पशुमान् भवति यत् समं प्रतिष्ठितं तद् गतश्रीर् यजेत प्रतिष्ठितं वा एतत् प्रतिष्ठित एष यो गतश्रीस् तद् एवैनं प्रतिष्ठापयति पापो हि स ततः प्रच्यवमानो ऽथ यस्य देवयजनस्यापः पुरस्तात् तद् यजेत यः कामयेताभि मोत्तरो यज्ञो नमेद् इत्य् एतद् वै पुरोहविर् नाम देवयजनम् अभ्य् एनम् उत्तरो यज्ञो नमत्य् अथ यस्य देवयजनस्य पन्थाः पुरस्ताद् इरिणं वा कर्तो वा भ्रातृव्यवान् यजेतैतद् वा आप्तं देवयजनं सदेवं यद् धि देवयजनाद् देवयजनम् उञ्शिंषेद् भ्रातृव्याय लोकम् उञ्शिंषेद् अथ यस्य देवयजनस्याहवनीयाद् अन्याः प्राचीर् आपो धावन्ति गार्हपत्याद् अन्याः प्रतीचीस् तद् यजेत यं तल्पे वा पात्रे वा मीमांसेरन्न् अनुषक्तो हि वा एष पाप्मनाथैतन् मीमांसन्त एतद् वै व्यावृत्तं पाप्मना पाप्मनैवैनं व्यावर्तयन्ति यद् वै यज्ञः संतिष्ठते प्राचीनम् अस्य समृद्धम् एति प्रतीचीनं व्यृद्धं पशवो वै यज्ञस्य समृद्धम् आपः खलु वै पशवो यत् प्रत्यङ्ङ् अवभृथम् अभ्यवेयाद् यज्ञस्य व्यृध्येन व्यृध्येताथ यत् प्राङ् अवभृथम् अभ्यवैति यज्ञस्य वा एतत् समृध्येन समृध्यते यत् त्र्युन्नतं तद् भ्रातृव्यवान् यजेत यस्याहवनीयं च हविर्धानं चान्तरोन्नतं यस्य हविर्धानं च सदश् चान्तरोन्नतं यस्य सदश् च गार्हपत्यं चान्तरोन्नतम् अतो वै विष्णुर् इमांल् लोकान् उदजयद् विष्णोर् एवोज्जितम् अन्व् इमांल् लोकान् उज्जयति प्रैभ्यो लोकेभ्यो भ्रातृव्यं नुदते ऽथ यस्य देवयजनस्य दक्षिणत उन्नतं तद् भ्रातृव्यवान् यजेतैतां वै दिशं देवा असुरान् प्रणुद्य स्वर्गं लोकम् आयन्न् अथैभ्यो ऽमुम् आदित्यं परिधिं पर्यदधुर् अपुनराभावायैतां वा एतद् दिशं यजमानो भ्रातृव्यं प्रणुद्य स्वर्गं लोकम् एत्य् अथास्मा अमुम् आदित्यं परिधिं परिदधात्य् अपुनराभावाय स्थले यजेत यः कामयेतोभयेषां देवमनुष्याणां प्रकाशं गछेयम् इति प्रकाशो वै नामैतद् देवयजनम् उभयेषां देवमनुष्याणां प्रकाशं गछत्य् अभिशस्यमानं याजयेत् परोक्षं गुहा वने परोक्षं पृष्ठान्य् अपेयुः परोक्षं वा एष यम् अभिशंसन्ति परोक्षम् एवास्माद् गुहा पापीयां वाचं करोत्य् अथ यस्य होता प्रातरनुवाकम् अनुब्रुवन्न् अग्निम् अपः सूर्यं तानि पश्येत् तद् ब्रह्मवर्चसकामो यजेत ब्रह्मवर्चसं वा अग्निर् ब्रह्मवर्चसम् आपो ब्रह्मवर्चसम् अस्मा आदित्यो ब्रह्मवर्चसम् एव संदधाति ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवत्य् अथ यस्य देवयजनस्यान्याअन्या मध्यतो बहुला ओषधयो ऽतो वा अङ्गिरसः पशून् असृजन्त तत् पशुकामो यजेताथ यस्य देवयजनस्य मध्यत उन्नतम् अतो वा अङ्गिरसः स्वर्गं लोकम् आयंस् तत् स्वर्गकामो यजेत निर्वस्के ऽभिचरन् यजेत यथैवैतं निर्णयत्य् एवं तं निर्णयति यम् अभिचरति यत् कार्यम् इव स्यात् तद् यजेत यः कार्य इव स्याद् आत्मा वै देवयजनं करोत्य् एवैनं ये युवान आर्षेया ऋत्विजो वह्नयस् तद् देवयजनं तस्माद् आहुर् युवैवार्त्विजीना इत्य् अग्निर् वाव देवयजनं तद् य एवं विद्वान् यत्रैव क्वचाग्निम् आधाय यजते देवयजन एव यजते ॥
3.8.4.m: Thirty-six steps to the east, twenty-four at the front, thirty at the back: thus it is commensurate with the Virāj. Moreover, the Virāj is indeed the metres; it is the metres that he thereby yokes at the mouth of the sacrifice. Concerning this, indeed, this [verse] has been recited: / 'Indrāṇī won a glorious victory with her husband, through her portion she broke forth into the winning of a husband, / thirty yojanas are her hips; in her lap she bears the mighty Indra.' / That which slopes towards the east is the place of worship; for they found him lying facing east. Then that which slopes towards the east and leans away towards the north, on that should he sacrifice who may desire: 'May I prosper in both worlds.' This [site] indeed belongs to both worlds; in both worlds indeed he prospers. Then of which place of worship there is another place of worship to the north, on that should he sacrifice who may desire: 'May a higher sacrifice bend towards me.' That place of worship is indeed named Uttarávat ('Possessing a North/Superior'); a higher sacrifice bends towards him. Then of which place of worship there are abundant plants in the middle, on that should he sacrifice who is desirous of cattle: plants are indeed cattle; he becomes rich in cattle. That which is level and firm, on that should he who has attained fortune sacrifice. That is indeed firm; firm is he who has attained fortune. Thus he establishes him firmly; for he would be wretched, tumbling away from that. Then of which place of worship waters are to the east, on that should he sacrifice who may desire: 'May a higher sacrifice bend towards me.' That place of worship is indeed named Puróhavis ('Having an Oblation in Front'); a higher sacrifice bends towards him. Then of which place of worship there is a path in front, or a cleft, or a chasm, on that should one having a rival sacrifice. This place of worship is indeed secured, accompanied by the gods; for if he were to leave over a place of worship from the place of worship, he would leave over space for his rival. Then of which place of worship other waters run east from the Āhavanīya, and other waters west from the Gārhapatya, on that should he sacrifice concerning whom people have doubts regarding bed or cup; for he is indeed attached to evil; then they doubt about this. This indeed is separation from evil; with evil itself they separate him. When indeed the sacrifice is completed, what is east goes to success, what is west to failure. Cattle are indeed the success of the sacrifice; waters are certainly cattle. If he were to go down to the final bath facing west, he would meet with failure through the failure of the sacrifice. But when he goes down to the final bath facing east, he succeeds through the success of the sacrifice. That which is raised in three places, on that should one having a rival sacrifice: between whose Āhavanīya and Havirdhāna it is raised, between whose Havirdhāna and Sadas it is raised, between whose Sadas and Gārhapatya it is raised. From here indeed Viṣṇu conquered these worlds; following Viṣṇu's conquest, he conquers these worlds; he drives the rival out from these worlds. Then of which place of worship it is raised to the south, on that should one having a rival sacrifice. In this direction indeed the gods, having driven out the Asuras, went to the heavenly world. Then for them they put around that sun as an enclosing stick, so that they should not return. In this direction indeed the sacrificer, having driven out the rival, goes to the heavenly world. Then for him he puts around that sun as an enclosing stick, so that he should not return. On a mound should he sacrifice who may desire: 'May I come into the sight of both gods and men.' This place of worship is indeed named Prakāśa ('Clear Sight'); he comes into the sight of both gods and men. He should cause him to sacrifice who is being accused: unseen, hidden, in a forest, unseen the backs [of hills] should run away. Unseen indeed is he whom they accuse; unseen, hidden from him he makes worse speech. Then of which place of worship the Hotṛ reciting the morning litany might see them—Agni, the waters, the sun—on that should he sacrifice who is desirous of spiritual splendor. Agni is indeed spiritual splendor, the waters are spiritual splendor, the sun joins spiritual splendor unto him; he becomes endowed with spiritual splendor. Then of which place of worship there are various abundant plants in the middle, from here indeed the Aṅgirases created cattle; on that should he sacrifice who is desirous of cattle. Then of which place of worship it is raised in the middle, from here indeed the Aṅgirases went to the heavenly world; on that should he sacrifice who is desirous of heaven. In a ravine should he sacrifice when practicing sorcery: just as he leads this out, so he leads out him against whom he practices sorcery. That which seems to require making, on that should he sacrifice who seems to need making. The place of worship is indeed the self; it makes him. The youthful Priests descended from Ṛṣis who are conveyers, that is the place of worship. Therefore they say: 'A youth alone is worthy of the office of priest.' Agni indeed is the place of worship. Therefore, he who knowing thus sacrifices having established the fire anywhere whatsoever, sacrifices on the place of worship itself.

aichanta sā nānyatarāṃścanopāvartata tāṃ devā apāśāsur upa nā āvartasveti sābravīd bhāgo me 'stv iti vṛṇīṣvety abruvan sābravīn mām eva parvām agner vyāghārayāt sa yatkāmo māṃ vyāghārayāt tam eva sa kāmam aśnuvad iti tāṃ devāḥ pūrvām agner vyāghārayaṃs tato devā abhavan parāsurās tad ya evaṃ vidvān etāṃ pūrvām agner vyāghārayati bhavaty ātmanā parāsya bhrātṛvyo bhavati yad vai tad utkramyātiṣṭhad antarā devāsurānt saṃyattānt siṃhīrupam iva bhūtvā sā vā uttaravedis taptāyanī me 'sīti taptā hi te tām avindanta vittāyanī me 'sīti vittā hi te tām avindantāvatān mā nāthitam iti nāthitāṃ hi sā tān āvad avatād vyathitam iti vyathitāṃ hi sā tān āvad etadetad vā etayā devā asurāṇām avindantaitadetad evaitayā yajamāno bhrātṛvyasya vṛṅkte 'gne aṅgiro yo 'syāṃ pṛthivyām adhyasīti ya evaiṣu triṣu lokeṣv agnayas tān evāvarunddhe vider agne nabho nāma yattā iti nabho hi nāma so 'gnir āsīd jānudaghnaṃ kheyametāvatī vā asyāḥ pṛthivyā jīvaṃ yajñiyaṃ tad evāvarunddhe siṃhīr asi mahiṣīr asīti siṃhīrūpam iva hi tan mahiṣīrūpam iva bhūtvātiṣṭhad devebhyaḥ śundhasva devebhyaḥ śumbhasveti devebhya evaināṃ śundhanti devebhyaḥ śumbhanti niḥsārayati yad evāsyā udghnantaḥ krūram akraṃs tad akrūram akas tan niḥsārayatīndraghoṣās tvā purastād vasubhiḥ pāntv ity etaddevatyā vā imā diśo yathādevatam evaināṃ praukṣīd ato vai devā asurān manasā vinudya svargaṃ lokam āyaṃs ta etā devatā antato 'dadhatāsurāṇām ananvagbhāvāyāto vā etad yajamāno bhrātṛvyaṃ manasā vinudya svargaṃ lokam eti sa etā devatā antato dhatte bhrātṛvyasyānanvagbhāvāya te 'kāmayanta sapatnaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ sahemahīti siṃhīr sāḍhvā paśūn bhittvā te 'kāmayanta prajānaḥ syād iti siṃhīr asi suprajāvaniḥ svāheti tam eva tena kāmam āśnuvata siṃhīr asy ādityavaniḥ sajātavaniḥ svāhety ādityābhir hi sā prajābhiḥ saha te 'kāmayanta devā no yajñaṃ vidyur iti siṃhīr asy āvaha devān devāyate yajamānāya svāheti tam eva tena kāmam āśnuvata bhūtebhyas tvety uddiśati devā hy eva bhūtā yatra vā ado 'gnir hotrād bhīṣāpākrāmat sa sarveṣu bhūteṣv avasad yāṃ paśuṣv avasat tām anāchinnastukasyāntarāśṛṅgam avasad yāṃ vanaspatiṣu pūtudrau yām oṣadhīṣu tāṃ sugandhitejane yat saṃbhārānt saṃbharati yad evātrāgner nyaktaṃ tat saṃbharati yāni vā ado 'gnir asthāny adhūnuta sa pūtudrur abhavad yan māṃsaṃ tad guggulu yat pūyitam upaśliṣṭaṃ sa sugandhitejano yad ete saṃbhārā bhavanti yad evātrāgner nyaktaṃ tasyāvaruddhyai viśvāyur asi pṛthivīṃ dṛṃhety eṣāṃ hy ete lokānāṃ vidhṛtyai paridhīyante dhruvakṣitir asy antarikṣaṃ dṛṃhety antarikṣaṃ hi yajño 'cyutakṣid asi divaṃ dṛṃheti divam evainam ajīgamad agner bhasmāsy agneḥ purīṣam asīty agner hy etad bhasmāgneḥ purīṣaṃ devapātraṃ vā uttaravedi devebhyo devapātraṃ procyaṃ vaibhrājā devā yad āha vibhrāḍ bṛhat pibatu somyaṃ madhv iti devebhyo vā etad devapātraṃ prāha pra vasīyasaḥ pātram āpnoti brāhmaṇaṃ tu pātre na mīmāṃseta yaḥ pātriya iva syāt ||
3.8.5.d: यद् वा अस्या यज्ञियं मेध्यं यत् सदेवं तद् उत्क्रम्यातिष्ठद् अन्तरा देवासुरान्त् संयतान्त् सिंहीरूपम् इव भूत्वा ते ऽविदुर् यतरान् वा इयम् उपावर्त्स्यति त इदं भविष्यन्तीति तस्यां वा उभय ऐछन्त सा नान्यतरांश्चनोपावर्तत तां देवा अपाशासुर् उप ना आवर्तस्वेति साब्रवीद् भागो मे ऽस्त्व् इति वृणीष्वेत्य् अब्रुवन् साब्रवीन् माम् एव पर्वाम् अग्नेर् व्याघारयात् स यत्कामो मां व्याघारयात् तम् एव स कामम् अश्नुवद् इति तां देवाः पूर्वाम् अग्नेर् व्याघारयंस् ततो देवा अभवन् परासुरास् तद् य एवं विद्वान् एतां पूर्वाम् अग्नेर् व्याघारयति भवत्य् आत्मना परास्य भ्रातृव्यो भवति यद् वै तद् उत्क्रम्यातिष्ठद् अन्तरा देवासुरान्त् संयत्तान्त् सिंहीरुपम् इव भूत्वा सा वा उत्तरवेदिस् तप्तायनी मे ऽसीति तप्ता हि ते ताम् अविन्दन्त वित्तायनी मे ऽसीति वित्ता हि ते ताम् अविन्दन्तावतान् मा नाथितम् इति नाथितां हि सा तान् आवद् अवताद् व्यथितम् इति व्यथितां हि सा तान् आवद् एतदेतद् वा एतया देवा असुराणाम् अविन्दन्तैतदेतद् एवैतया यजमानो भ्रातृव्यस्य वृङ्क्ते ऽग्ने अङ्गिरो यो ऽस्यां पृथिव्याम् अध्यसीति य एवैषु त्रिषु लोकेष्व् अग्नयस् तान् एवावरुन्द्धे विदेर् अग्ने नभो नाम यत्ता इति नभो हि नाम सो ऽग्निर् आसीद् जानुदघ्नं खेयमेतावती वा अस्याः पृथिव्या जीवं यज्ञियं तद् एवावरुन्द्धे सिंहीर् असि महिषीर् असीति सिंहीरूपम् इव हि तन् महिषीरूपम् इव भूत्वातिष्ठद् देवेभ्यः शुन्धस्व देवेभ्यः शुम्भस्वेति देवेभ्य एवैनां शुन्धन्ति देवेभ्यः शुम्भन्ति निःसारयति यद् एवास्या उद्घ्नन्तः क्रूरम् अक्रंस् तद् अक्रूरम् अकस् तन् निःसारयतीन्द्रघोषास् त्वा पुरस्ताद् वसुभिः पान्त्व् इत्य् एतद्देवत्या वा इमा दिशो यथादेवतम् एवैनां प्रौक्षीद् अतो वै देवा असुरान् मनसा विनुद्य स्वर्गं लोकम् आयंस् त एता देवता अन्ततो ऽदधतासुराणाम् अनन्वग्भावायातो वा एतद् यजमानो भ्रातृव्यं मनसा विनुद्य स्वर्गं लोकम् एति स एता देवता अन्ततो धत्ते भ्रातृव्यस्यानन्वग्भावाय ते ऽकामयन्त सपत्नं भ्रातृव्यं सहेमहीति सिंहीर् असि सपत्नसाही स्वाहेति तम् एव तेन कामम् आशुनुवत सपत्नं भ्रातृव्यं साढ्वा ते ऽकामयन्त पशवो नः स्युर् इति सिंहीर् असि रायस्पोषवनिः स्वाहेति तम् एव तेन कामम् आश्नुवत सपत्नं भ्रातृव्यं साढ्वा पशून् भित्त्वा ते ऽकामयन्त प्रजानः स्याद् इति सिंहीर् असि सुप्रजावनिः स्वाहेति तम् एव तेन कामम् आश्नुवत सिंहीर् अस्य् आदित्यवनिः सजातवनिः स्वाहेत्य् आदित्याभिर् हि सा प्रजाभिः सह ते ऽकामयन्त देवा नो यज्ञं विद्युर् इति सिंहीर् अस्य् आवह देवान् देवायते यजमानाय स्वाहेति तम् एव तेन कामम् आश्नुवत भूतेभ्यस् त्वेत्य् उद्दिशति देवा ह्य् एव भूता यत्र वा अदो ऽग्निर् होत्राद् भीषापाक्रामत् स सर्वेषु भूतेष्व् अवसद् यां पशुष्व् अवसत् ताम् अनाछिन्नस्तुकस्यान्तराशृङ्गम् अवसद् यां वनस्पतिषु पूतुद्रौ याम् ओषधीषु तां सुगन्धितेजने यत् संभारान्त् संभरति यद् एवात्राग्नेर् न्यक्तं तत् संभरति यानि वा अदो ऽग्निर् अस्थान्य् अधूनुत स पूतुद्रुर् अभवद् यन् मांसं तद् गुग्गुलु यत् पूयितम् उपश्लिष्टं स सुगन्धितेजनो यद् एते संभारा भवन्ति यद् एवात्राग्नेर् न्यक्तं तस्यावरुद्ध्यै विश्वायुर् असि पृथिवीं दृंहेत्य् एषां ह्य् एते लोकानां विधृत्यै परिधीयन्ते ध्रुवक्षितिर् अस्य् अन्तरिक्षं दृंहेत्य् अन्तरिक्षं हि यज्ञो ऽच्युतक्षिद् असि दिवं दृंहेति दिवम् एवैनम् अजीगमद् अग्नेर् भस्मास्य् अग्नेः पुरीषम् असीत्य् अग्नेर् ह्य् एतद् भस्माग्नेः पुरीषं देवपात्रं वा उत्तरवेदि देवेभ्यो देवपात्रं प्रोच्यं वैभ्राजा देवा यद् आह विभ्राड् बृहत् पिबतु सोम्यं मध्व् इति देवेभ्यो वा एतद् देवपात्रं प्राह प्र वसीयसः पात्रम् आप्नोति ब्राह्मणं तु पात्रे न मीमांसेत यः पात्रिय इव स्यात् ॥
3.8.5.m:
Whatever of her was fit for sacrifice, pure, divine, that, having stepped forth, stood between the gods and the Asuras engaged in conflict, having as it were taken the form of a lioness.
They knew:
"To whichever side this one turns, they will become this [world]."
Both [sides] indeed desired her.
She did not turn to either side.
The gods implored her:
"Turn to us!"
She said:
"Let there be a share for me."
"Choose!" they said.
She said:
"Let him besprinkle me indeed prior to Agni.
Whatever desire he desires when besprinkling me, that very desire let him attain."
The gods besprinkled her prior to Agni.
Thereupon the gods became [supreme];
the Asuras were defeated.
Therefore, he who, knowing thus, besprinkles this one prior to Agni becomes [supreme] in his own self; his rival is defeated.
That which, having stepped forth, stood between the gods and the Asuras engaged in conflict, having as it were taken the form of a lioness,
that indeed is the Uttara-vedi.
"You are my approach through heat,"
for having suffered heat, they found her.
"You are my approach through finding,"
for having found, they found her.
"Protect me, who am distressed,"
for she protected them who were distressed.
"Protect me, who am troubled,"
for she protected them who were troubled.
This and that the gods found of the Asuras by her;
this and that the sacrificer takes away from his rival by her.
"O Agni, O Aṅgiras, who are upon this earth,"
whatever fires there are in these three worlds, those he secures.
"You know, O Agni, that 'Nabhas' is your name,"
for that Agni had the name 'Nabhas'.
It should be dug knee-deep.
Verily, the living, sacrificial part of this earth is down to that depth;
that very [part] he secures.
"You are a lioness;
you are a buffalo cow,"
for having become as it were the form of a lioness, as it were the form of a buffalo cow, she stood.
"Purify yourself for the gods;
adorn yourself for the gods,"
for the gods indeed they purify her,
for the gods they adorn her.
He clears [it] out;
whatever cruel [deed] they did to her in digging up, that he has made non-cruel;
that he clears out.
"Let Indra's shouts protect you from the east with the Vasus,"
these quarters indeed have these deities;
according to their deities he has sprinkled her.
From here indeed the gods, having driven away the Asuras with the mind, went to the heavenly world.
They placed these deities at the end so that the Asuras would not follow.
From here indeed the sacrificer, having driven away his rival with the mind, goes to the heavenly world;
he places these deities at the end so that his rival does not follow.
They desired:
"May we overcome the hostile rival!"
"You are a lioness, overcoming rivals, svāhā!"
that very desire they attained through that.
Having overcome the hostile rival, they desired:
"May cattle be ours!"
"You are a lioness, winning increase of wealth, svāhā!"
that very desire they attained through that.
Having overcome the hostile rival, having gained cattle, they desired:
"May offspring be ours!"
"You are a lioness, winning good offspring, svāhā!"
that very desire they attained through that.
"You are a lioness, winning the Ādityas, winning kinsmen, svāhā!"
For she is together with the offspring belonging to the Ādityas.
They desired:
"May the gods know our sacrifice!"
"You are a lioness;
bring hither the gods for the sacrificer who strives for the gods, svāhā!"
that very desire they attained through that.
"For the beings, to you," he designates;
for the gods indeed are the beings.
When, over there, Agni fled out of fear from the office of Hotṛ, he lived in all beings.
That [portion of him] which he lived among cattle, he lived between the horns of an uncut tuft;
that which [he lived] among trees, in the pūtudru tree;
that which [he lived] among plants, in fragrant grass.
When he collects the materials,
whatever of Agni was concealed here, that he collects.
The bones of Agni that he shook off over there, that became the pūtudru tree;
what was flesh, that was guggulu;
what was putrid and adhered, that was fragrant grass.
When these materials are [gathered],
[it is] for securing whatever of Agni was concealed here.
"You are all-sustaining life;
make the earth firm!"
For these [enclosing sticks] are laid around for the support of these worlds.
"You are a steadfast dwelling;
make the atmosphere firm!"
For the sacrifice is indeed the atmosphere.
"You are an unshakeable dwelling;
make heaven firm!"
To heaven indeed he caused it to go.
"You are the ashes of Agni;
you are the loose earth of Agni,"
for this is the ashes of Agni, the loose earth of Agni.
The Uttara-vedi is indeed the drinking vessel of the gods.
The drinking vessel of the gods is to be announced to the gods.
The gods are radiant.
When he says:
"Let the radiant, the great one, drink the honeyed Soma-drink,"
he announces this drinking vessel of the gods to the gods.
He obtains the drinking vessel of one who is more prosperous;
but he should not question a Brahmin about the vessel who is, as it were, worthy of a vessel.

3.8.6.s: etāvatī vā iyaṃ pṛthivī yāvatī vedir aparimitād vā etad bhrātṛvyaṃ nirbhajya yajamānāya parigṛhṇāty ṛkṣaṃ vā amedhyam āpo havir yat prokṣati medhyam evainat karoty ṛkṣaṃ vā amedhyaṃ yad barhiḥ stṛṇāti medhyām evaināṃ karoty etāvatī vā iyaṃ pṛthivī yāvatī vediḥ prajā barhir yad barhiḥ stṛṇāty asyāṃ vā etat prajāḥ pratiṣṭhāpayati yajamāno vai prastaraḥ prajā barhir yat prastaram uttaraṃ barhiṣaḥ sādayati yajamānaṃ vā etad upariṣṭād āsāṃ prajānāṃ dadhāty atha yat tṛṇe antardadhāti tena yajamāno yajamānena vyāvartate bahulaṃ barhiḥ stṛṇāty akṣodhukā asya paśavo bhavanti prācīnaṃ barhiḥ stṛṇāti prāṅ hi yajño yat pratīcīnaṃ stṛṇīyāt pratyādājyāsya rāṣṭraṃ ghātukaṃ syād deveṣur vai vedir yatra vai deveṣvā saṃnatayā kāmayate tad dhanti yad vediṃ kalpayati deveṣuṃ vā etat saṃnamati tayā saṃnatayā yatra yajamānaḥ kāmayate tad dhanti trayo vai pūrve 'gnayaḥ prādhanvan havyaṃ devebhyo vahanto vaṣaṭkāraḥ prāvṛścad atha yo 'yam idānīṃ sa bhīṣāpādravad īdṛg u sa āriṣyatīti taṃ devā apāśāsur upa nā āvartasveti so 'bravīd bhāgo me 'stv iti vṛṇīṣvety abruvan so 'bravīt trayo vai me pūrve bhrātaraḥ prādhanvan havyaṃ devebhyo vahanto vaṣaṭkāraḥ prāvṛścat teṣāṃ bhāgo 'stv iti vṛṇīṣvety abruvan so 'bravīd yad eva kiṃcāhutaṃ bahiṣparidhi skandet tad eva teṣāṃ bhāgadheyam asad iti teṣāṃ vā etad bhāgadheyam asthanvanto hi vai ta āsann atha te prādhanvan so 'bravīd asthāni nu dhaviṣye 'thopāvartsyāmīti te vā anvāyaṃs te samantaṃ paryaviśan yajñasya gopīthāyāyaṃ vāva yajñāyopadhīyate 'yaṃ yajamānāyāyaṃ bhrātṛvyāyemau prataraṃ karotīmam apataraṃ yajñena vā etad yajamānaṃ prataraṃ karoti yajñenāsya bhrātṛvyam apataraṃ karoti saṃdhiṃ pratijuhoti na hy agnim āhutis tarati mukhata evainān prīṇāty atho sutīrthena vā etad āhutīs tārayaty ayaṃ vāva bhūpatir ayaṃ bhuvanapatir ayaṃ bhūtānāṃ patir atha yo 'yam idānīṃ sa bhūtir yad āhutaṃ bahiṣparidhi skandet tad abhimantrayeta || bhūpataye svāhā bhuvanapataye svāhā bhūtānāṃ pataye svāhā || iti bhāgadheyaṃ vāvaiṣām etat prīṇāty evainān atho haviṣā vā etat skannena dvitīyām āśiṣam avarunddha etad dha sma vā āhāruṇa aupaveśiḥ kim u sa yajñena yajeta yo haviṣā skannena dvitīyām āśiṣam avarundhaṃ na vidyād iti tad dvitīyām evaitenāśiṣam avarunddhe ||
3.8.6.d: एतावती वा इयं पृथिवी यावती वेदिर् अपरिमिताद् वा एतद् भ्रातृव्यं निर्भज्य यजमानाय परिगृह्णात्य् ऋक्षं वा अमेध्यम् आपो हविर् यत् प्रोक्षति मेध्यम् एवैनत् करोत्य् ऋक्षं वा अमेध्यं यद् बर्हिः स्तृणाति मेध्याम् एवैनां करोत्य् एतावती वा इयं पृथिवी यावती वेदिः प्रजा बर्हिर् यद् बर्हिः स्तृणात्य् अस्यां वा एतत् प्रजाः प्रतिष्ठापयति यजमानो वै प्रस्तरः प्रजा बर्हिर् यत् प्रस्तरम् उत्तरं बर्हिषः सादयति यजमानं वा एतद् उपरिष्टाद् आसां प्रजानां दधात्य् अथ यत् तृणे अन्तर्दधाति तेन यजमानो यजमानेन व्यावर्तते बहुलं बर्हिः स्तृणात्य् अक्षोधुका अस्य पशवो भवन्ति प्राचीनं बर्हिः स्तृणाति प्राङ् हि यज्ञो यत् प्रतीचीनं स्तृणीयात् प्रत्यादाज्यास्य राष्ट्रं घातुकं स्याद् देवेषुर् वै वेदिर् यत्र वै देवेष्वा संनतया कामयते तद् धन्ति यद् वेदिं कल्पयति देवेषुं वा एतत् संनमति तया संनतया यत्र यजमानः कामयते तद् धन्ति त्रयो वै पूर्वे ऽग्नयः प्राधन्वन् हव्यं देवेभ्यो वहन्तो वषट्कारः प्रावृश्चद् अथ यो ऽयम् इदानीं स भीषापाद्रवद् ईदृग् उ स आरिष्यतीति तं देवा अपाशासुर् उप ना आवर्तस्वेति सो ऽब्रवीद् भागो मे ऽस्त्व् इति वृणीष्वेत्य् अब्रुवन् सो ऽब्रवीत् त्रयो वै मे पूर्वे भ्रातरः प्राधन्वन् हव्यं देवेभ्यो वहन्तो वषट्कारः प्रावृश्चत् तेषां भागो ऽस्त्व् इति वृणीष्वेत्य् अब्रुवन् सो ऽब्रवीद् यद् एव किंचाहुतं बहिष्परिधि स्कन्देत् तद् एव तेषां भागधेयम् असद् इति तेषां वा एतद् भागधेयम् अस्थन्वन्तो हि वै त आसन्न् अथ ते प्राधन्वन् सो ऽब्रवीद् अस्थानि नु धविष्ये ऽथोपावर्त्स्यामीति ते वा अन्वायंस् ते समन्तं पर्यविशन् यज्ञस्य गोपीथायायं वाव यज्ञायोपधीयते ऽयं यजमानायायं भ्रातृव्यायेमौ प्रतरं करोतीमम् अपतरं यज्ञेन वा एतद् यजमानं प्रतरं करोति यज्ञेनास्य भ्रातृव्यम् अपतरं करोति संधिं प्रतिजुहोति न ह्य् अग्निम् आहुतिस् तरति मुखत एवैनान् प्रीणात्य् अथो सुतीर्थेन वा एतद् आहुतीस् तारयत्य् अयं वाव भूपतिर् अयं भुवनपतिर् अयं भूतानां पतिर् अथ यो ऽयम् इदानीं स भूतिर् यद् आहुतं बहिष्परिधि स्कन्देत् तद् अभिमन्त्रयेत ॥ भूपतये स्वाहा भुवनपतये स्वाहा भूतानां पतये स्वाहा ॥ इति भागधेयं वावैषाम् एतत् प्रीणात्य् एवैनान् अथो हविषा वा एतत् स्कन्नेन द्वितीयाम् आशिषम् अवरुन्द्ध एतद् ध स्म वा आहारुण औपवेशिः किम् उ स यज्ञेन यजेत यो हविषा स्कन्नेन द्वितीयाम् आशिषम् अवरुन्धं न विद्याद् इति तद् द्वितीयाम् एवैतेनाशिषम् अवरुन्द्धे ॥
3.8.6.m: This earth is as large as the altar. Having excluded the rival from what is unmeasured, he encloses it for the sacrificer. Bare indeed is impure; water is an oblation. When he sprinkles, he makes it pure. Bare indeed is impure. When he strews the sacred grass, he makes it pure. This earth is as large as the altar; offspring are the sacred grass. When he strews the sacred grass, he establishes offspring upon this [earth]. The sacrificer is the prastara; offspring are the sacred grass. When he places the prastara higher than the sacred grass, he places the sacrificer above these offspring. Now when he inserts two blades of grass, thereby the sacrificer becomes distinct from the [other] sacrificer. He strews thick sacred grass; his cattle become free from hunger. He strews the sacred grass pointing east, for the sacrifice points east. If he were to strew it pointing west, his kingdom would be liable to fall upon each other and be destructive. The altar is a divine arrow. Where one desires with a bent divine arrow, there it strikes. When he prepares the altar, he bends the divine arrow. With it bent, where the sacrificer desires, there it strikes. Three former fires perished carrying the oblation to the gods; the Vaṣaṭ-call cut them down. Then this one who is now fled in fear: "Will he injure me in such a way?" The gods implored him: "Turn to us!" He said: "Let there be a share for me." "Choose!" they said. He said: "Three former brothers of mine perished carrying the oblation to the gods; the Vaṣaṭ-call cut them down. Let there be a share for them." "Choose!" they said. He said: "Whatever unoffered [portion] might spill outside the enclosing sticks, let that be their share." That is indeed their share. For they had bones, and then they perished. He said: "Now I will shake off my bones; then I will turn back." They followed him; they sat around completely for the protection of the sacrifice. This one is placed down for the sacrifice, this one for the sacrificer, this one for the rival. He makes these two further forward, this one further away. By the sacrifice, he makes the sacrificer further forward; by the sacrifice, he makes his rival further away. He offers over the joint, for an oblation does not cross Agni. From the front, he pleases them; and he makes the oblations cross by a good ford. This one is the Lord of the earth; this one is the Lord of the world; this one is the Lord of beings; and this one who is now is Prosperity. If the offered [portion] should spill outside the enclosing sticks, he should recite over it: / 'To the Lord of the earth, svāhā! / To the Lord of the world, svāhā! / To the Lord of beings, svāhā!' / That is indeed their share; he pleases them. Moreover, through the spilled oblation he attains a second blessing. Thus indeed Aruṇa Aupaveśi used to say: 'Why should he sacrifice with a sacrifice who does not know how to attain a second blessing with a spilled oblation?' Thus by this he attains a second blessing.

3.8.7.s: ye purā granthayo bhavanti tān visraṃsayanti mānuṣasya vyāvṛttyai praṇenijati yad evainayor abhiniṣaṇṇaṃ śamalam amedhyaṃ tañ śundhanti yuñjate mana uta yuñjate dhiyā iti juhoti yuktyā eva sāvitryā juhoti savitṛprasūte eva pravartete havir vai havirdhāne yad upānakti havirbhūta eva pravartete atho abhivṛtte eva patny upānakti yad vai patnī yajñe karoti tan mithunaṃ mithunatvāya vai patny upānakty eṣa vai patnyā yajñasyānvārambho yad yajñe karoty anvārambhāya vai patny upānakti prācīnam upānakti prāṅ hi yajñas trir anyat trir anyad upānakty aparimitaṃ hi manuṣyā upāñjanti dakṣiṇata upānakty udīcī hy ete manuṣyalokam upāvartete nirṛtigṛhīto vā eṣa ubhayataḥ saṃdaṣṭaḥ śuṣko yad upānakti śamayaty eva śuṣko vā eṣa durvāg yajamānasya gṛham āvadati sa īśvaro 'śānto yajamānaṃ hiṃsitos tad anugṛhṇanto yanti yady utkṣvedet suvāg āvada deva duryān iti vadec chamayaty evātho śamayitvaivāśiṣam āśāste havir vai havirdhāne stīrtvā vai barhir havir āsādayanti tasmāt prastaraṃ stīrtvā pravartayanti havir vai havirdhāne anūcyamānāsu vai sāmidhenīṣu havir āsādayanti tasmāt pravartyamānayor hotānvāheme vā ete ime vā etat pravartayanti yad dhavirdhāne tasmāt pūrvasyā janatātā aparā janatā kṣetram abhyārohukā te yarhi pravartayeyus tarhi hotānubruvan manasā padā tāṃ janatāṃ pratinuded apa janyaṃ bhayaṃ nudeti viḍ vā eṣā viśaṃ vā etat pratinudate 'nabhyavacārukāsya viṭ kṣetraṃ bhavati nīyānaṃ vai rakṣāṃsi yajñam avayanti yad vartmani juhoti rakṣasām apahatyai vaiṣṇavyā juhoti viṣṇur vai yajño viṣṇunaiva yajñena yajñād rakṣāṃsy apahanti yad gāyatryā juhotīmāṃ tenākramate yat triṣṭubhāntarikṣaṃ tenātha yad āhavanīyaṃ gachataḥ svargaṃ tena lokaṃ trīn prakramān prativikramate trayo vā ime lokā imān eva lokān yajamānāyoñśiṃṣati vaiṣṇavam asi viṣṇus tvottabhnātv iti vaiṣṇavaṃ hi havirdhānaṃ divo viṣṇa uta vā pṛthivyā iti dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya methīn nihanti mukhata eva yajñasyāśiṣam avarunddhe yam adhvaryuḥ prathamaṃ granthiṃ grathnāti taṃ prathamaṃ visraṃsayati yad anyaṃ pūrvaṃ visraṃsayed amehena pramīyeta viṣṇor nu kaṃ vīryāṇi pravocam ity uttarasya havirdhānasya methīn nihanti vaiṣṇavyā vaiṣṇavaṃ hi havirdhānaṃ svayaiva devatayā yo askabhāyad uttaraṃ sadhastham ity ado vā uttaraṃ sadhastham amuṣminn eva havirdhānaṃ saṃminoti || ā vām upastham adruhā devāḥ sīdantu yajñiyāḥ | ihādya somapītaye || iti ya eva devā yajñiyās tān havirdhānā āsādayati tāṃ śvo bhūte 'bhiyajate daṇḍo vā etad auparo vaṣaṭkāreṇa nirahan yac chadir abhinidadhāty apihityā achidratvāya viṣṇoḥ pṛṣṭham asīty ada eva viṣṇo rarāṭam asīty ada eva viṣṇoḥ śipre sthā itīme eva mukhato vā etat svayā devatayā śiro yajñasya saṃbharati viṣṇoḥ syūr asīti tasmād idaṃ śiraḥ ṣoḍhāviṣkṛtaṃ pra tad viṣṇuḥ stavate vīryeṇeti prāṅ uktramya vadaty ato vai viṣṇur imāṃl lokān udajayad viṣṇor evojjitim anv imāṃl lokān ujjayati praibhyo lokebhyo bhrātṛvyaṃ nudate ||
3.8.7.d: ये पुरा ग्रन्थयो भवन्ति तान् विस्रंसयन्ति मानुषस्य व्यावृत्त्यै प्रणेनिजति यद् एवैनयोर् अभिनिषण्णं शमलम् अमेध्यं तञ् शुन्धन्ति युञ्जते मन उत युञ्जते धिया इति जुहोति युक्त्या एव सावित्र्या जुहोति सवितृप्रसूते एव प्रवर्तेते हविर् वै हविर्धाने यद् उपानक्ति हविर्भूत एव प्रवर्तेते अथो अभिवृत्ते एव पत्न्य् उपानक्ति यद् वै पत्नी यज्ञे करोति तन् मिथुनं मिथुनत्वाय वै पत्न्य् उपानक्त्य् एष वै पत्न्या यज्ञस्यान्वारम्भो यद् यज्ञे करोत्य् अन्वारम्भाय वै पत्न्य् उपानक्ति प्राचीनम् उपानक्ति प्राङ् हि यज्ञस् त्रिर् अन्यत् त्रिर् अन्यद् उपानक्त्य् अपरिमितं हि मनुष्या उपाञ्जन्ति दक्षिणत उपानक्त्य् उदीची ह्य् एते मनुष्यलोकम् उपावर्तेते निरृतिगृहीतो वा एष उभयतः संदष्टः शुष्को यद् उपानक्ति शमयत्य् एव शुष्को वा एष दुर्वाग् यजमानस्य गृहम् आवदति स ईश्वरो ऽशान्तो यजमानं हिंसितोस् तद् अनुगृह्णन्तो यन्ति यद्य् उत्क्ष्वेदेत् सुवाग् आवद देव दुर्यान् इति वदेच् छमयत्य् एवाथो शमयित्वैवाशिषम् आशास्ते हविर् वै हविर्धाने स्तीर्त्वा वै बर्हिर् हविर् आसादयन्ति तस्मात् प्रस्तरं स्तीर्त्वा प्रवर्तयन्ति हविर् वै हविर्धाने अनूच्यमानासु वै सामिधेनीषु हविर् आसादयन्ति तस्मात् प्रवर्त्यमानयोर् होतान्वाहेमे वा एते इमे वा एतत् प्रवर्तयन्ति यद् धविर्धाने तस्मात् पूर्वस्या जनताता अपरा जनता क्षेत्रम् अभ्यारोहुका ते यर्हि प्रवर्तयेयुस् तर्हि होतानुब्रुवन् मनसा पदा तां जनतां प्रतिनुदेद् अप जन्यं भयं नुदेति विड् वा एषा विशं वा एतत् प्रतिनुदते ऽनभ्यवचारुकास्य विट् क्षेत्रं भवति नीयानं वै रक्षांसि यज्ञम् अवयन्ति यद् वर्त्मनि जुहोति रक्षसाम् अपहत्यै वैष्णव्या जुहोति विष्णुर् वै यज्ञो विष्णुनैव यज्ञेन यज्ञाद् रक्षांस्य् अपहन्ति यद् गायत्र्या जुहोतीमां तेनाक्रमते यत् त्रिष्टुभान्तरिक्षं तेनाथ यद् आहवनीयं गछतः स्वर्गं तेन लोकं त्रीन् प्रक्रमान् प्रतिविक्रमते त्रयो वा इमे लोका इमान् एव लोकान् यजमानायोञ्शिंषति वैष्णवम् असि विष्णुस् त्वोत्तभ्नात्व् इति वैष्णवं हि हविर्धानं दिवो विष्ण उत वा पृथिव्या इति दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्य मेथीन् निहन्ति मुखत एव यज्ञस्याशिषम् अवरुन्द्धे यम् अध्वर्युः प्रथमं ग्रन्थिं ग्रथ्नाति तं प्रथमं विस्रंसयति यद् अन्यं पूर्वं विस्रंसयेद् अमेहेन प्रमीयेत विष्णोर् नु कं वीर्याणि प्रवोचम् इत्य् उत्तरस्य हविर्धानस्य मेथीन् निहन्ति वैष्णव्या वैष्णवं हि हविर्धानं स्वयैव देवतया यो अस्कभायद् उत्तरं सधस्थम् इत्य् अदो वा उत्तरं सधस्थम् अमुष्मिन्न् एव हविर्धानं संमिनोति ॥ आ वाम् उपस्थम् अद्रुहा देवाः सीदन्तु यज्ञियाः । इहाद्य सोमपीतये ॥ इति य एव देवा यज्ञियास् तान् हविर्धाना आसादयति तां श्वो भूते ऽभियजते दण्डो वा एतद् औपरो वषट्कारेण निरहन् यच् छदिर् अभिनिदधात्य् अपिहित्या अछिद्रत्वाय विष्णोः पृष्ठम् असीत्य् अद एव विष्णो रराटम् असीत्य् अद एव विष्णोः शिप्रे स्था इतीमे एव मुखतो वा एतत् स्वया देवतया शिरो यज्ञस्य संभरति विष्णोः स्यूर् असीति तस्माद् इदं शिरः षोढाविष्कृतं प्र तद् विष्णुः स्तवते वीर्येणेति प्राङ् उक्त्रम्य वदत्य् अतो वै विष्णुर् इमांल् लोकान् उदजयद् विष्णोर् एवोज्जितिम् अन्व् इमांल् लोकान् उज्जयति प्रैभ्यो लोकेभ्यो भ्रातृव्यं नुदते ॥
3.8.7.m: The knots that were there before, those they untie, / for the distinction from what belongs to mortals. / They wash [the two carts]. / Whatever stain, [whatever] impure [matter] has adhered to the two, that they cleanse. / With "They yoke the mind and they yoke the thoughts," he offers [an oblation], / indeed for yoking. / With [a verse] addressed to Savitṛ he offers: / urged by Savitṛ they two roll forward. / The two Havirdhāna [carts] are indeed an oblation. / When he anoints [them], / they two roll forward indeed having become an oblation. / Moreover, when they have rolled forward, the wife anoints [them]. / What a wife does at the sacrifice, that is a pair; / indeed for pairing the wife anoints. / This indeed is the wife's holding on to the sacrifice: what she does at the sacrifice; / indeed for holding on the wife anoints. / She anoints [them] facing forward; / for the sacrifice is directed forward. / Three times one, three times the other she anoints; / for human beings anoint without measure. / She anoints from the south; / for facing north these two turn towards the world of men. / Seized by Nirṛti, indeed, is this dried-up [axle] pinched on both sides. / When he anoints [it], / he thereby appeases [it]. / Dry, indeed, [and] ill-speaking, this one cries out to the house of the sacrificer; / it would be capable, being unappeased, of injuring the sacrificer. / Therefore, supporting [it], they go along. / If it should creak, he should say: "Fair-speaking, god, speak to the dwellings!" / He thereby appeases [it]. / Moreover, only after appeasing [it] does he invoke a blessing. / The two Havirdhāna [carts] are indeed an oblation. / Having strewn the sacred grass, indeed, they set down the oblation; / therefore, having strewn the prastara, they roll [them] forward. / The two Havirdhāna [carts] are indeed an oblation. / While the Sāmidhenī [verses] are being recited, indeed, they set down the oblation; / therefore, while the two are being rolled forward, the Hotṛ recites [after them]. / These indeed are these [two]; / these two indeed roll forward when the two Havirdhānas [do]. / Therefore another folk is eager to ascend upon the territory of a former folk. / When they roll [them] forward, then the Hotṛ, reciting, should thrust back that folk with his foot in mind: / "Thrust away danger arising from [other] folk!" / That [other folk] is indeed the people; / the people indeed he thus thrusts back. / Its people becomes not liable to invade his territory. / The Rakṣases indeed track the sacrifice along its track. / When he offers in the wheel-track, / [it is] for striking away the Rakṣases. / With [a verse] addressed to Viṣṇu he offers; / Viṣṇu indeed is the sacrifice. / By means of Viṣṇu, through the sacrifice, he strikes away the Rakṣases from the sacrifice. / When he offers with a Gāyatrī, with that he steps upon this [earth]; / when with a Triṣṭubh, with that upon the intermediate space; / and when the two go to the Āhavanīya, with that [he steps upon] the heavenly world. / He strides three strides; / three indeed are these worlds; / these worlds indeed he secures for the sacrificer. / "You belong to Viṣṇu; / may Viṣṇu prop up you!" / for the Havirdhāna belongs to Viṣṇu. / With "From heaven, O Viṣṇu, or from earth," he drives down the pin of the southern Havirdhāna [cart]; / from the very mouth of the sacrifice he wins the blessing. / Which knot the Adhvaryu ties first, that one he unties first; / if he were to untie another first, he would die of retention of urine. / With "Now indeed let me proclaim the heroic deeds of Viṣṇu," he drives down the pin of the northern Havirdhāna [cart] with [a verse] addressed to Viṣṇu; / for the Havirdhāna belongs to Viṣṇu; / [it is] through its own deity. / "Who propped up the upper dwelling," [he says]; / yonder indeed is the upper dwelling; / in yonder one he firmly sets up the Havirdhāna. // / "Into your lap let the harmless gods, worthy of sacrifice, sit / here today for drinking Soma," / [he says]; / whichever gods are worthy of sacrifice, them he sets upon the two Havirdhānas; / them he sacrifices to on the morrow. / A hornless staff, indeed, he drove out with the vaṣaṭ-call. / When he puts on the roof, / [it is] for covering, for freedom from gaps. / "You are the back of Viṣṇu,"—that is yonder [roof]; / "You are the forehead of Viṣṇu,"—that is yonder [front]; / "You are the two corners of the mouth of Viṣṇu,"—these are these two; / from the mouth indeed, with its own deity, he brings together the head of the sacrifice. / "You are the sewing of Viṣṇu," [he says]; / therefore this head is displayed in six parts. / "Forward indeed is Viṣṇu praised for his heroic deed," having stepped forward towards the east, he says; / from here indeed Viṣṇu conquered these worlds; / following the conquest of Viṣṇu, he conquers these worlds; / from these worlds he thrusts away his rival.

3.8.8.s: devasya tvā savituḥ prasava iti savitṛprasūta evainām ādatte 'śvinor bāhubhyām ity aśvinau vai devānām adhvaryuḥ pūṣṇo hastābhyām iti devatābhir evābhrir asi nārir asīti krūram iva vā etad yad abhriḥ śamayaty evedam ahaṃ rakṣaso grīvā apikṛntāmīty āha rakṣasāṃ dhvarāyai rakṣasām antarityaīdam ahaṃ some samāno yo 'samāno 'rātīyati tasya grīvā apikṛntāmīti samāno vā hy asamāno vārātīyati sarvam evaitayā paryāpat prāṇā vā uparavāḥ śiro havirdhānaṃ śīrṣan vā ime prāṇās tasmād dhavirdhāne 'ntar vā ime śīrṣan prāṇās tasmād antaś catvāro vā ime śīrṣan prāṇās tasmāc catvāraḥ saṃtṛṇṇāḥ paraḥ saṃtṛṇṇā hi paraḥ prāṇā vidhṛtā upariṣṭād vidhṛtā hīma upariṣṭāt prāṇāḥ pūrvārdhe vā ime mukhasya prāṇā etat khalu vai havirdhānasya pūrvārdhaṃ yad dakṣiṇaṃ havirdhānaṃ tasmād dakṣiṇe havirdhāne bṛhann asi bṛhadrāyā iti devā hy eva bṛhad bṛhatīm indrāya vācaṃ vadety aindro hi yajño rakṣohaṇaṃ valagahanam ity āha rakṣasāṃ dhvarāyai rakṣasām antarityai vaiṣṇavīm iti viṣṇur hi yajño 'surā vā etān valagān devebhyaḥ prāṇeṣu nyakhanaṃs tān bāhumātre 'nvavindaṃs tasmād bāhumātraṃ kheyaṃ yad vāva kṛtyā yañ śaphaṃ yad abhicaritaṃ tad etad udvapati prāṇā vā uparavās yad avasiñcati tasmād ima udanvantaḥ prāṇāḥ prāṇā vā uparavā yad avastṛṇāti tasmād ime lomaśāḥ prāṇā atha yad avasiñcaty ava ca stṛṇāti mastiṣko vā eṣa kriyate hanū adhiṣavaṇe śiro havirdhānaṃ śīrṣan vā ime hanū tasmād dhavirdhāne 'ntar vā ime śīrṣan hanū tasmād antar ime vā ete yat saṃtṛndyād ime eva saṃtṛndyāt tat saṃpādye eva dvyaṅgulam antarā kāryaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ hīdam antarā vai nākeva śiro havirdhānaṃ pṛṣṭham āgnīdhram udaraṃ sadaḥ prāṅ hi yajñaḥ saṃhito hanū adhiṣavaṇe jihvādhiṣavaṇaṃ grāvāṇo dantā mukhato vā etat prajāpateḥ somaṃ pibantīndro vai vṛtram ahan sa imāṃ prāviśat taṃ devatāḥ praiṣam aichaṃs tan nāvidaṃs taṃ bhūtāny upāravanta yo no 'dhipatir abhūt tan na vindāmā iti tad uparavāṇām uparavatvaṃ yat tad upāravanta tac caturdhāvastād evaichann ekadhā paro 'nvavindaṃs tasmāc caturdhāvastād ekadhā paro yad uparavān anumṛśatīndriyasyāvaruddhyai ||
3.8.8.d: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसव इति सवितृप्रसूत एवैनाम् आदत्ते ऽश्विनोर् बाहुभ्याम् इत्य् अश्विनौ वै देवानाम् अध्वर्युः पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम् इति देवताभिर् एवाभ्रिर् असि नारिर् असीति क्रूरम् इव वा एतद् यद् अभ्रिः शमयत्य् एवेदम् अहं रक्षसो ग्रीवा अपिकृन्तामीत्य् आह रक्षसां ध्वरायै रक्षसाम् अन्तरित्यईदम् अहं सोमे समानो यो ऽसमानो ऽरातीयति तस्य ग्रीवा अपिकृन्तामीति समानो वा ह्य् असमानो वारातीयति सर्वम् एवैतया पर्यापत् प्राणा वा उपरवाः शिरो हविर्धानं शीर्षन् वा इमे प्राणास् तस्माद् धविर्धाने ऽन्तर् वा इमे शीर्षन् प्राणास् तस्माद् अन्तश् चत्वारो वा इमे शीर्षन् प्राणास् तस्माच् चत्वारः संतृण्णाः परः संतृण्णा हि परः प्राणा विधृता उपरिष्टाद् विधृता हीम उपरिष्टात् प्राणाः पूर्वार्धे वा इमे मुखस्य प्राणा एतत् खलु वै हविर्धानस्य पूर्वार्धं यद् दक्षिणं हविर्धानं तस्माद् दक्षिणे हविर्धाने बृहन्न् असि बृहद्राया इति देवा ह्य् एव बृहद् बृहतीम् इन्द्राय वाचं वदेत्य् ऐन्द्रो हि यज्ञो रक्षोहणं वलगहनम् इत्य् आह रक्षसां ध्वरायै रक्षसाम् अन्तरित्यै वैष्णवीम् इति विष्णुर् हि यज्ञो ऽसुरा वा एतान् वलगान् देवेभ्यः प्राणेषु न्यखनंस् तान् बाहुमात्रे ऽन्वविन्दंस् तस्माद् बाहुमात्रं खेयं यद् वाव कृत्या यञ् शफं यद् अभिचरितं तद् एतद् उद्वपति प्राणा वा उपरवास् यद् अवसिञ्चति तस्माद् इम उदन्वन्तः प्राणाः प्राणा वा उपरवा यद् अवस्तृणाति तस्माद् इमे लोमशाः प्राणा अथ यद् अवसिञ्चत्य् अव च स्तृणाति मस्तिष्को वा एष क्रियते हनू अधिषवणे शिरो हविर्धानं शीर्षन् वा इमे हनू तस्माद् धविर्धाने ऽन्तर् वा इमे शीर्षन् हनू तस्माद् अन्तर् इमे वा एते यत् संतृन्द्याद् इमे एव संतृन्द्यात् तत् संपाद्ये एव द्व्यङ्गुलम् अन्तरा कार्यं द्व्यङ्गुलं हीदम् अन्तरा वै नाकेव शिरो हविर्धानं पृष्ठम् आग्नीध्रम् उदरं सदः प्राङ् हि यज्ञः संहितो हनू अधिषवणे जिह्वाधिषवणं ग्रावाणो दन्ता मुखतो वा एतत् प्रजापतेः सोमं पिबन्तीन्द्रो वै वृत्रम् अहन् स इमां प्राविशत् तं देवताः प्रैषम् ऐछंस् तन् नाविदंस् तं भूतान्य् उपारवन्त यो नो ऽधिपतिर् अभूत् तन् न विन्दामा इति तद् उपरवाणाम् उपरवत्वं यत् तद् उपारवन्त तच् चतुर्धावस्ताद् एवैछन्न् एकधा परो ऽन्वविन्दंस् तस्माच् चतुर्धावस्ताद् एकधा परो यद् उपरवान् अनुमृशतीन्द्रियस्यावरुद्ध्यै ॥
3.8.8.m: "At the impulse of the god Savitṛ," [he says]; / urged by Savitṛ he takes it. / "With the arms of the Aśvins," [he says]; / the Aśvins are the Adhvaryu of the gods. / "With the hands of Pūṣan," [he says]; / by means of the deities [he takes it]. / "You are a spade; you are a woman," [he says]; / cruel as it were is this that is a spade; / he pacifies it. / "Here do I cut off the neck of the Rakṣas," he says, / for the injury of the Rakṣasas, for the destruction of the Rakṣasas. / "Here do I cut off the neck of him who, an equal or an unequal, behaves with hostility in [regard to] the Soma," [he says]; / for whether an equal or an unequal behaves with hostility, / he encompasses all with this [formula]. / The Uparavas are the vital breaths; / the Havirdhāna [shed] is the head. / In the head indeed are these vital breaths; / therefore [they are] in the Havirdhāna. / Inside the head indeed are these vital breaths; / therefore [they are] inside. / Four indeed are these vital breaths in the head; / therefore four are perforated beyond; / for the vital breaths are perforated beyond. / Separated above; / for separated above are these vital breaths. / In the front part of the face indeed are these vital breaths. / The southern Havirdhāna is indeed the front part of the Havirdhāna. / Therefore [they are excavated] in the southern Havirdhāna. / "Great are you, having great wealth," [he says]; / for the gods are indeed great. / "Speak a great speech to Indra," [he says]; / for the sacrifice belongs to Indra. / "Slayer of Rakṣas, slayer of charms," he says, / for the injury of the Rakṣasas, for the destruction of the Rakṣasas. / "Belonging to Viṣṇu," [he says]; / for the sacrifice is Viṣṇu. / The Asuras indeed buried these charms for the gods in the vital breaths. / They found them at arm's length. / Therefore it is to be dug arm's length deep. / Whatever sorcery, whatever curse, whatever bewitchment [there is], that he thus digs up. / The Uparavas are the vital breaths. / When he pours down [water], / therefore these vital breaths are watery. / The Uparavas are the vital breaths. / When he strews down [grass], / therefore these vital breaths are hairy. / Now when he pours down [water] and strews down [grass], / this brain indeed is made. / The two pressing-boards are the jaws; / the Havirdhāna is the head. / In the head are these two jaws; / therefore [they are] in the Havirdhāna. / Inside the head are these two jaws; / therefore inside are these two. / If he were to perforate [them], he would perforate these [jaws]. / They are simply to be brought together. / A space of two finger-breadths is to be made between [them]; / for this [space between the jaws] is two finger-breadths. / Between [them] indeed like the vault of heaven. / The Havirdhāna is the head; / the Āgnīdhra is the back; / the Sadas is the belly; / for the sacrifice is joined facing forward. / The two pressing-boards are the jaws; / the pressing-cloth is the tongue; / the pressing-stones are the teeth. / From the mouth of Prajāpati they thus drink Soma. / Indra indeed slew Vṛtra. / He entered into this [earth]. / The deities sought to search for him. / They did not find him. / The beings raised a cry towards him: / "He who was our overlord, him we do not find." / That is why the Uparavas are called Uparavas. / That they then raised a cry, thus they sought [him] fourfold from below. / They found [him] singly beyond. / Therefore fourfold below, / singly beyond. / When he touches the Uparavas, / [it is] for the securing of virility.

3.8.9.s: pṛthivyai tvāntarikṣāya tvā dive tveti prokṣaty eṣā hy eṣāṃ lokānāṃ vidhṛtyai mīyate triḥ prokṣati triṣatyā hi devā atho trayo vā ime lokā ebhya evaināṃ lokebhyaḥ praukṣīd annaṃ vai yavā ūrg udumbaro yad yavamatībhiḥ prokṣaty ūrjā vā etad annaṃ samardhayaty ṛkṣaṃ vā amedhyam āpo havir yad avasiñcati medhyam evainat karoty ṛkṣaṃ vā amedhyaṃ yad avastṛṇāti medhyam evainat karoti pitṛdevatyaṃ vai nikhātam amedhyam anyadevatyam asyāḥ khalu vā imā uttamārdha oṣadhayo yad avastṛṇāty asyā evainām uttamārdhe minoty anikhātaivābhūd annaṃ vai yavā ūrg udumbaro yad yavam avāsyaty anne vā etad ūrjaṃ dadhāti na hy annam ṛta ūrjo dhinoti no hy ūrg ṛte 'nnād dhinoti nitānas tvā māruto nihantv iti mano vai nitānaḥ prāṇā mārutā mitrāvaruṇau dhruveṇa dharmaṇeti mitram evaināṃ dādhāra varuṇaḥ kalpayati vidhṛtyai ca khalu vā eṣāṃ prajānāṃ kḷptyai ca mīyate mitrāvaruṇau vai devānāṃ dharmadhārayau daivaṃ vā etad dharmam adīdharatāṃ yad audumbarī brahmavaniṃ tvā kṣatravaniṃ paryūhāmīty āśīr evaiṣā brahma dṛṃha kṣatraṃ dṛṃhety āśiṣa evaiṣa parigraho ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī āpṛṇeti ghṛtenaiva dyāvāpṛthivī vyunatty udaraṃ vai sada ūrg udumbaro yad audumbary ūrjaṃ vā etan madhyata ātmano abhinidadhāti gotrādgotrād dhi prasarpanty udaraṃ vai sado yad anyenānyena saṃminoti tasmād udaram anyenānyenāmena saṃtata udaraṃ vai sado yad anūcīnaṃ minuyāt parācīnaṃ jagdham atīyād atha yat
